Apotheosis – Ascension to Godhood
Vol.6

Chapter 501
In the history of the Central Domain, Feng Guanyu was the one with the highest attainments in runes. The Sect Protecting Grand Array he had drawn was still in service in the Void Spirit Sect, playing a huge role.
The Sect Protecting Grand Array of the Void Spirit Sect was enough to withstand the attack of a False Tribulation Realm martial artist. If the Sect Protecting Grand Array was controlled by six martial artists, regardless of their strength, as long as they understood the principles behind the Sect Protecting Grand Array, they could even kill a False Tribulation Realm martial artist!
Such a Sect Protecting Grand Array was of little value to martial artists who didn't establish their own sect. However, to a sect, its value was enormous. It was even more important than a saint artifact!
However, ever since Feng Guanyu's death, no one in the world had a perfect brush stroke. Even if a new Sect Protecting Grand Array of the Void Spirit Sect was set up, the effect would still be far from meeting the requirements.
No one would have thought that Luo Zheng, who was in front of them, would only change a hundred or so runes, and be able to make the barrier of the arena reach such power. It could even withstand a punch from a Life and Death Realm martial artist. Was this guy really drawing runes? If it was a rune, what kind of rune could stimulate the energy to condense such a powerful barrier?
What Luo Zheng drew was, of course, not runes, but divine runes.
The sect masters of the Central Domain naturally couldn't imagine the power of divine runes.
In the True Dragon World, the Great Thousand Treasure Array drawn by Qinglong could even withstand the attack of a Super Divine Beast!
However, in the Central Domain, due to the limitations of materials, Luo Zheng naturally couldn't draw the Great Thousand Treasure Array. Moreover, Luo Zheng didn't have the strength to draw a nine star rune, or even a ten star rune.
Seeing his attack blocked by the light barrier of the arena, Cui Xie was more surprised than anyone else. Seeing the tip of Luo Zheng's sword pressed against Si Miaoling's neck, he coldly said, "I'm not interested in negotiating with an ant, but you're an exception. Speak, what do you want?"
In Cui Xie's view, Luo Zheng had enough time to kill Si Miaoling, but he still didn't kill her. He must have some purpose.
Luo Zheng narrowed his eyes and looked behind Cui Xie. He said coldly, "Release Luo Yan."
Hearing Luo Zheng's words, Cui Xie was finally stunned. There were very few things that could make Cui Xie stunned. After a while, Cui Xie said with a complicated expression, "I remember, I've seen you before …"
At this moment, Cui Xie finally remembered that he had met Luo Zheng once at the Blue Cloud Sect!
In fact, Cui Xie should have thought of this from the beginning. However, with his status, he didn't care about Luo Zheng at all. After Luo Zheng broke Cui Yun's Heart of Martial Arts, Cui Xie's heart was filled with anger. All he wanted was to take revenge for Si Miaoling!
However, he neglected the fact that Luo Zheng had come straight for Si Miaoling. His goal was the same as Ao Xiang's.
In fact, what surprised Cui Xie the most was that the young man he had glanced at at at the Blue Cloud Sect had actually grown to this point in less than a year. Moreover, he had even found an opportunity to coerce Cui Xie into letting go of his sister. This was simply inconceivable!
"Ha, ha … I really don't understand. I, Cui Xie, just took away two girls, but these juniors still came looking for trouble with me. Is it because I'm not worthy of my title as the strongest man in the Central Domain? Am I too easy to bully?" Cui Xie suddenly said with a self-mocking smile.
"No," Luo Zheng said with a serious expression, "It's because you took away my sister."
Although Luo Zheng's words sounded calm, it was like a sudden clap of thunder in the minds of many cultivators.
His words were simply too arrogant …
Just because she was his sister, Cui Xie had to pay such a price?
Saying something like this in front of Cui Xie, wasn't he just courting death?
Many cultivators couldn't think straight anymore. Most of them were thinking the same thing in their minds.
How big was the gap between the Divine Reflection realm and the Life and Death realm? It was a gap of two whole realms, and the gap between them was the Divine Core realm and the False Tribulation realm. This was no longer the gap between an ant and an elephant, it was the gap between a mortal and an immortal!
Cui Xie stared at Luo Zheng with a sharp gaze. He was so angry that he started laughing. "Looks like you're even more arrogant than me! What if I don't let Luo Yan go? "
"She'll die." Luo Zheng said calmly. The longsword in his hand trembled a little.
"You dare kill her?" Cui Xie's expression darkened.
"Why wouldn't I?" Luo Zheng had promised Luo Yan that he would save her. If Si Miaoling didn't die, once the Six Senses Sealing Art was removed, Luo Yan would definitely be tortured by Cui Xie. Therefore, either Luo Yan was saved, or Si Miaoling was killed. There was no third possibility.
"Eastern Evil Lord, why don't we just let this matter go? After all, Luo Yan is his sister … "The Sect Chief of the Black Mountain Sect, Hei Ya, suddenly said.
Madame Poison Blood also spoke with a soft voice, "Brother Cui, this isn't a life and death grudge. It's understandable that Luo Zheng wants to take his sister away."
Both Sect Chiefs jumped out at this moment. Their purpose was simple, they wanted to side with Luo Yan. If they could convince Cui Xie to let Luo Yan go, they would be able to openly ask Luo Zheng to construct a Sect Protecting Grand Formation for their sect. With such a Sect Protecting Grand Formation, it would bring endless benefits to their sect. Perhaps, it wouldn't take them long to develop from a Fourth Grade Sect to a Fifth Grade Sect!
"Both of you, shut up!" Cui Xie scolded with a cold voice.
After being scolded by Cui Xie, Madame Poison Blood and Hei Ya immediately stopped talking. Although they were both experts at the Late Stage of the False Tribulation Realm, they were still not strong enough in front of Cui Xie.
Cui Xie waved his hand and pulled Luo Yan, who was standing there like a block of wood, over. He put his big hand on Luo Yan's delicate neck and said, "Luo Zheng, if you let Si Miaoling go, after I take Luo Yan's Primordial Yin, I can return your sister to you unscathed. What do you think?"
Luo Zheng's eyelids drooped. After a while, he raised his head and suddenly laughed loudly, "Hahaha!"
"What do you mean?" Cui Xie asked.
Luo Zheng pointed at him and said angrily, "You're dreaming! You took away a woman's most precious thing, and you want to return it to me unscathed? What a 'unscathed'! Hahaha! "
Hearing Luo Zheng's wild laughter, Cui Xie's face became gloomy, "Otherwise, after my Great Demonic Joyous Union Array, she will die a miserable death! After I ravage her, I will burn her bones and scatter her ashes! "
After saying that, he tightened his grip on Luo Yan's neck. However, Luo Yan was still as motionless as a block of wood. Her six senses had been sealed. She couldn't hear, see, smell, or even touch her skin. She was completely sealed.
"Miserable? So what if I kill her? "
Luo Zheng's eyes flashed with a dangerous glint. He shook the sword in his hand, and with a flash of sword light, a stream of blood suddenly shot out from Si Miaoling's neck. He actually killed Si Miaoling with a single sword strike!
"You!" Seeing Luo Zheng kill Si Miaoling, Cui Xie's eyes almost split open. He never thought that this kid would have such guts!
Seeing Luo Zheng kill Si Miaoling in front of all the Sect Masters, their hearts skipped a beat.
Daoist Priest Qing Xu sighed inwardly. 'This is bad!'
The three Alliance Masters revealed bitter expressions. Today's matter couldn't be resolved peacefully! The three instantly arrived in front of the stage. Ning Yudie also walked down the stage. Cold Qi flickered around her body. Obviously, she had already entered battle mode.
In the stands, some of the more astute martial artists turned around and ran …
The aftershock of a False Tribulation Realm powerhouse's attack was enough to shatter these martial artists. Now that the number one person in the Central Domain, a Life and Death Realm powerhouse, was about to make a move, how could they continue? If they fought, even the slightest aftershock would be enough to kill a large number of people. If they didn't run now, when would they run?
"Luo Zheng was too impulsive. He shouldn't have killed Si Miaoling," Pei Tianyao shook his head.
Red Maple curled his lips, "I can only say that this guy is too fierce. He really dared to kill Si Miaoling. He's simply throwing caution to the wind. Is there anyone fiercer than him in this world?"
Hua Tianming thoughtfully said, "If it were me, I would also kill her."
"Why?" Pei Tianyao asked, puzzled.
"If he killed Si Miaoling, Cui Xie's Heavenly Demon Joyous Union Array would have one less person. It would take him a lot of time to find the next Extreme Violet Yin Body woman who also needs to maintain her virginity. It might take a year, ten years, or even a hundred years. As long as he can fight for this time, he will have a chance to defeat Cui Xie," Hua Tianming said seriously, "And today, Luo Zheng might not necessarily fall into a dead end."
＝＝＝＝＝

Chapter 502
In the world of martial artists, the law of the jungle was like a golden rule. It was reflected in all aspects.
If you were strong enough, then you were the sky. If you were strong enough, then everyone would bow down to you. If you were strong enough, then even if you called a deer a horse, or inverted black and white, there would still be people who would agree with you!
All money, power, and status needed to be protected by strong strength.
If a martial artist had an Extreme Purple Yin Body sister, then he would most likely be willing to offer her to Cui Xie. As long as he could ask for Cui Xie's protection, or even a little reward, then he would benefit immensely.
But today, Luo Zheng, who was as weak as an ant, was standing in the dilapidated arena. Yet, he had proven two words: dignity!
Even if Cui Xie was the strongest person in the Central Domain, Luo Zheng didn't show any signs of bowing down. When he killed Si Miaoling, he didn't hesitate at all.
Facing the furious Cui Xie, Luo Zheng's face didn't show the slightest ripple. His eyes were fixed on Luo Yan, the sister he cared about the most.
The wind was getting stronger and stronger.
The Yuan Qi of heaven and earth was also restless.
"Hualala …"
The basalt rock under Cui Xie's feet was already full of cracks. At this moment, it was collapsing circle by circle.
A torrential killing intent was brewing in Cui Xie's body. It was like a volcano that was about to erupt. Luo Yan's face was a little red because Cui Xie's hand was unconsciously strangling her neck. In order to take in more air, her chest was rapidly rising and falling.
Cui Xie didn't think that Luo Zheng would really dare to kill Si Miaoling. This kid didn't seem to know what fear was.
The dignified number one person in the Central Domain, a Life and Death Realm expert who had survived three life and death tribulations, was unexpectedly defeated by a Divine Reflection Realm kid! His bone age was only 18 years old. To Cui Xie, who had lived for hundreds of years, he was as young as a baby!
Cui Xie really wanted to squeeze Luo Yan's neck. If he exerted a little bit of force, Luo Yan's fragile neck would be crushed by him. However, he had already spent several decades gathering the three Extreme Violet Yin Bodies.
Si Miaoling was dead. If he killed Luo Yan as well, who knew how long he would have to wait for the Great Heavenly Demon Joyous Union Array …
In the Life and Death Realm, one would have to face the tribulation of life and death. The Great Sky Demon Joyous Union Array was the foundation for him to break through the Life and Death Realm and reach the Divine Sea Realm. If he couldn't gather three Extreme Purple Yin Bodies, he would most likely die under one of the heavenly tribulations, never to reach the Divine Sea Realm in this lifetime!
"Since you killed Si Miaoling, then you should also die!" Cui Xie put Luo Yan aside and directly stepped down from the high platform. He walked in the air and walked towards the arena.
"Brother Cui Xie, please think twice about this!" Shi Kefan's face no longer had that playful smile on it.
"Those who stop me will die," Cui Xie coldly said as he walked in the air with heavy steps.
"Weng weng weng …"
A several zhang high ice wall appeared at the edge of the arena. The Profound Ice Halberd was placed behind Ning Yudie. Her face was filled with determination. "Luo Zheng is my Cloud Hall's disciple."
Cui Xie sneered as he looked at Ning Yudie. "Little girl, I advise you to step aside. You … aren't enough for me to beat!"
"So what?" Ning Yudie didn't show the slightest bit of fear. An Ice Phoenix flew over from the distance and stopped on Ning Yudie's shoulder. That Ice Phoenix also looked at Cui Xie with vigilance.
"If my disciple isn't enough for you to beat, then I'm afraid I'm not enough for you to beat either, right?" An old voice sounded. Then, a stooped figure appeared in the air and walked over with a cane. This old woman's steps were very slow, but her speed was very fast. In just a few steps, she was already standing in front of Ning Yudie.
"Master …" Seeing her master come over, Ning Yudie timidly shouted.
The old woman fiercely glared at Ning Yudie. In fact, the old woman was very dissatisfied with Ning Yudie's actions. After all, Ning Yudie's actions were tantamount to following Luo Zheng and bringing the entire Cloud Hall into the fire pit!
However, Ning Yudie was her beloved disciple. She didn't care about Luo Zheng's life or death, but she couldn't let anything happen to Ning Yudie.
"Granny Yu," Cui Xie shook his head, "You are indeed not enough for me to beat."
Ning Yudie's master, the previous Hall Master of the Cloud Hall, was also a Life and Death Realm expert. However, Granny Yu had only gone through one Heavenly Tribulation after entering the Life and Death Realm. Moreover, she was old and her Qi and blood were declining. She was no match for Cui Xie.
Just as they were confronting each other, another voice that was even older than Granny Yu's sounded, "In the Martial Arts Conference, life and death are up to fate. This is the rule set by our World Business Alliance for hundreds of years. Cui Xie, don't tell me you don't know this rule?"
Why did Cui Xie walk so slowly?
His goal was to test the waters.
The only people present who could make Cui Xie have some scruples was Granny Yu, and the other was the 1,700-year-old giant from the World Business Alliance!
As for Daoist Qing Xu and the Master of the Mysterious Yin Mansion, they might be a little troublesome for Cui Xie. However, this matter had nothing to do with their Sects, so they wouldn't interfere.
He didn't expect that the ancient giant from the World Business Alliance would still appear.
Cui Xie's brows wrinkled.
If it was a one-on-one fight, he was confident that he could win against these fourth-grade Sect Masters, fifth-grade Sect Masters, and even the ancient giant from the World Business Alliance. However, if he had to deal with these people alone …
Even if the three fat Alliance Masters worked together, Cui Xie would still have some trouble, not to mention Granny Yu and that 1,000-year-old monster.
"You don't have to pay the price for killing my people?" Cui Xie said indifferently. He was indeed the number one person in the Central Domain, but in the face of Tianqi City, which was surrounded by experts, he had no choice but to admit defeat!
"A debt of blood must be paid in blood. However, don't settle your conflict in Tianqi City. Outside of Tianqi City, no one will stop you." The old man from the World Business Alliance sat cross-legged, floating in the air. This old man was dressed very plainly, with only a plain white robe. Moreover, this white robe had many patches, as if it was an old robe that had been worn for many years.
"Is that so?" Cui Xie sneered. Suddenly, he stared at Ning Yudie and said with a smile, "I'm very interested in destroying the Cloud Hall. What do you think?"
"That's your own business," the old man replied.
"Okay." Cui Xie turned around and ordered two servants to collect Si Miaoling's body on the stage. Then, he took Luo Yan and another woman and was about to leave.
"Wait." Luo Zheng's voice sounded again.
Cui Xie turned his head and stared at Luo Zheng.
"You won't kill Luo Yan, right?" Luo Zheng asked.
Cui Xie sneered but didn't answer. It seemed that Luo Zheng wasn't qualified to ask him this question.
He left, but the pressure was still there.
Cui Xie was all alone. The Cloud Hall and the World Business Alliance had offended him today, so they were afraid that they would have to face his revenge.
Was it worth it for a little Divine Reflection Stage guy? Everyone thought about this matter at the same time.
After Elder Xiao removed the light barrier, he looked at the messy stage with an ugly expression. The stage was already ruined to this extent. Was the next battle still going to continue?
However, just as he removed the light barrier, Granny Yu staggered forward. With this step, Granny Yu arrived in front of Luo Zheng. The crutch in her hand swept across Luo Zheng's chest!
"Bang!"
Luo Zheng, who was hit by the crutch, flew out and heavily smashed into the side of the stage. His whole body was embedded in the stage, and his surroundings were full of cracks.
"Master …" Seeing that Luo Zheng was hit by her master, Ning Yudie called out in a low voice.
"Cui Xie is definitely not a kind person. My Cloud Hall will face his endless revenge in the future. How can we live peacefully? How can we carry it forward? "Granny Yu's old face said angrily.
Luo Zheng came out of the stage and said sternly, "You were the one who told me that Si Miaoling would appear at the Martial Arts Conference!"
"I didn't let Ning Yudie throw herself into danger! Throw the Cloud Hall into danger! "Granny Yu said angrily.
That day, Granny Yu thought that Luo Zheng would kill Si Miaoling himself. She didn't think that Ning Yudie would appear!
If Ning Yudie didn't want to face Cui Xie, Granny Yu wouldn't have come forward either. Luo Zheng was indeed outstanding! But in comparison, Cui Xie was even more terrifying! A single Cloud Hall couldn't possibly fight against Cui Xie. If Cui Xie came to find them in the future, how could the Cloud Hall deal with him?
However, Granny Yu blamed the wrong person. After all, Luo Zheng didn't beg Ning Yudie to come forward. It was Ning Yudie who insisted on standing in front of Luo Zheng and offended Cui Xie.
In fact, Granny Yu also knew that today's matter couldn't be blamed on Luo Zheng. It was Ning Yudie who insisted on coming forward. However, she had always doted on this disciple. How could she vent her anger on Ning Yudie? She could only vent her anger on Luo Zheng.
In other words, Ning Yudie had saved Luo Zheng's life, and Luo Zheng had helped Ning Yudie take a blow from the crutch. No matter how one looked at it, Luo Zheng had still profited. If one included the Grandmist Celestial Scourge generated from the crutch, Luo Zheng's profit would be even greater.

Chapter 503
Although Luo Zheng hadn't been able to bring Luo Yan back, he had achieved his goal of killing Si Miaoling and delaying the opening of the Great Demonic Joyous Union Array.
The Extreme Violet Yin Physique was extremely rare to begin with. Cui Xie had already spent several decades gathering three women with the Extreme Violet Yin Physique. As for the next Extreme Violet Yin Physique, who knew how long he would have to wait?
Perhaps ten years, perhaps fifty years …
No matter what, Luo Zheng was pressed for time. If he wanted to save Luo Yan, he had to quickly grow stronger. No one knew when the next Extreme Violet Yin Body would appear or when Cui Xie would find it!
Unfortunately, he and Luo Yan had parted ways. This time, they could only look at each other from afar. Luo Yan's six senses had been sealed, so they couldn't even communicate with each other through eye contact.
After Cui Xie left, he only left behind a high platform that had collapsed into pieces.
Many of the cultivators in the stands had lingering fears. They all looked at Luo Zheng and whispered to each other.
"This Luo Zheng is probably the craziest cultivator in the history of the Central Domain. He actually dared to kill someone in front of Cui Xie."
"Not to mention a Divine Reflection Realm cultivator, even a False Tribulation Realm cultivator would tremble in fear in front of Cui Xie. Not only did he threaten Cui Xie, but he also killed Si Miaoling in front of him."
"What's even more amazing is that Cui Xie actually ate this humiliation and left! Heavens, is this still the Eastern Heretic Monarch? "
In everyone's hearts, Cui Xie was a supreme existence. Yet, he had been slapped in the face by a Divine Reflection Realm junior, who had even killed his people! This kind of thing was absolutely unprecedented and would never happen again!
If it weren't for the hundreds of thousands of pairs of eyes staring at him, who would dare believe that such a thing could happen?
Hua Tianming smiled faintly. "I guessed right. Luo Zheng did it."
Red Maple pursed his lips. "It's a pity that no one is betting with you this time. Otherwise, you would have made a fortune again." In the previous matches, Hua Tianming had won a lot of Red Maple's True Origin Stones. Unfortunately, besides returning the principal to Red Maple, Hua Tianming hadn't given him a single penny. This made the Red Maple feel extremely unbalanced.
"However, if Luo Zheng really wants to save Luo Yan, he still has a long way to go." Pei Tianyao said seriously.
Hua Tianming's gaze moved away from Luo Zheng and looked at the clear, cloudless sky. The deep vault of heaven revealed a strange shade of blue as she murmured, "Who doesn't have a long way to go on the path of martial arts …"
To become a martial artist, to pursue immortality, to surpass the peak, to roam the universe …
Many martial artists had set this goal for themselves from the beginning. However, since ancient times, there had been hundreds of billions of martial artists, and how many of them had been able to achieve it? The vast majority of people had fallen on the path of pursuing the peak of martial arts. Some had become piles of bones buried deep underground, some had become a stepping stone for others, and some had been dominated by greed and desire, falling into a monster that only knew how to enjoy life.
At this time, several Sect Masters walked down the high platform at the same time.
Madam Poison Blood smiled and said to Granny Yu, "Oh, Luo Zheng only did what he should do. He is also a disciple of your Cloud Hall. Why did you beat him so heavily?"
Granny Yu didn't have a good expression. She could understand Madam Poison Blood's purpose. Granny Yu said in a cold voice, "I am teaching my Cloud Hall disciple a lesson. What does it have to do with your Blood Wood Cliff?"
Madam Poison Blood didn't get angry at all. She turned to Luo Zheng and said in a soft voice, "Luo Zheng, come and let me have a look. It will be bad if you are injured. My Blood Wood Cliff has a kind of elixir …"
Hearing Madam Poison Blood's words, a layer of goosebumps appeared on Luo Zheng's body. He quickly said, "It's okay. I'm in good health. It's just a crutch. It won't hurt me."
Several Sect Masters paid so much attention to Luo Zheng because of Luo Zheng's rune technique. However, the Sect Masters of Blood Wood Cliff, Void Spirit Sect, and Black Mountain Sect couldn't ask directly. This question could only be asked by the fat man of the World Business Alliance.
No Sect would give up this opportunity to block the boundary of a Life and Death Realm master. No matter the price, they would get it. Even the World Business Alliance couldn't ignore it.
"Luo Zheng, that boundary … can you tell me what's going on?" Shi Kefan asked with a serious expression.
Ning Yudie and Grandma Yu's eyes flickered. No matter how Luo Zheng comprehended such a powerful rune technique, they didn't want Luo Zheng to say it.
Luo Zheng wasn't stupid. How could he admit to the matter of divine runes? He faintly smiled and said, "Alliance Master Shi, I was just lucky enough to obtain the rune inheritance of a senior. It was pure luck that I was able to block Cui Xie's punch."
While they were talking, Pagoda Master Nie and the others had already made their move.
If one had to say who was the most shocked by this boundary, it would be Pagoda Master Nie and the others.
After so many years of development, rune techniques had almost formed a perfect system in the Central Domain. It was very difficult for new developments to occur.
Therefore, very few new runes were born in the past few years. This was because all the paths that should be walked had already been walked by the predecessors. Even the most talented rune master would find it hard to find a new path.
This was also the reason why Feng Guanyu was able to become a legend in the rune world. Only Feng Guanyu's Sect Protecting Great Array could block the invasion of a False Tribulation Realm expert.
However, Luo Zheng's small display of skill today had completely overturned the concept of Pagoda Master Nie and the others.
In merely two hours, he had drawn more than a hundred runes and blocked Cui Xie's attack.
Until now, Pagoda Master Nie felt as if he was dreaming. He even had a premonition that because of Luo Zheng, the rune technique might advance by leaps and bounds.
Ever since the development of rune techniques hit a bottleneck, the status of rune masters slowly fell behind that of alchemists and refiners.
After all, alchemists could refine top quality pills to help martial artists break through realms. Or they could refine top quality medicines to help martial artists heal their injuries.
As for refiners, they were even more important. All sorts of Spirit Items, Immortal Items, and even Saint Items were created by refiners.
As for the runes created by rune masters, they could at most defend against the attack of a Divine Core warrior. Aside from the Sect Protecting Great Array of the Void Spirit Sect, all other runes couldn't do much to warriors above the Divine Core realm. Therefore, runes were slowly being used for cultivation. For example, the Illusion Formation was used to train the elites of the sect, and it was used to test their performance. Of course, these Illusion Formations were useful for the sect as well, but they weren't as important as pills and weapons.
Now, Luo Zheng had proven how frightening a rune master was!
Pagoda Master Nie dug out the runes that were buried not long ago with his bare hands. There were three big stone slabs, and each of them was engraved with three complicated Four Star Runes!
When the three of them each received a stone slab, they immediately poured their soul force into it!
Not long after that, a shocked expression emerged on the trio's faces.
"Just as I thought, these runes are completely different from the runes used in the Central Domain! This, this, how can they be so exquisite?!"
"The middle of the runes is forked, this is the biggest taboo in runes, how did it end up like this?!"
"I never expected this, I never expected this! The first half of the runes looked like useless runes, but when they extend to the bottom, they somehow connect back together! Is this something that a human can come up with?!"
Right at this moment, all three men were completely immersed in a special state, trying to sense the profoundness of the Divine Runes.
The complexity of the Divine Runes far surpassed the imagination of the Central Domain's Rune Masters. It must be known that the development of the Divine Runes in the higher realms took billions of years to develop. Moreover, the Divine Runes had experienced countless reincarnations. Compared to the Central Domain's rune techniques, it could be said that a wise old man who had lived for tens of thousands of years was compared to a baby who had been born for less than a day. The disparity between the two was simply immeasurable.
Just these three four star runes were enough to greatly benefit Pagoda Master Nie and the others. Their train of thought had been broadened. Because of this, Pagoda Master Nie and the other two managed to see through a trace of the Dao of Divine Inscriptions and jumped out of the rut of the Central Region's rune inscriptions. They brought the Central Region's rune inscriptions to a new height. Although it was impossible for them to surpass Luo Zheng's Divine Inscription Technique, they still created an era that surpassed Feng Guanyu. Of course, this was a story for later.
Seeing that Pagoda Master Nie and the others had directly dismantled Luo Zheng's runes, Daoist Priest Qing Xu and the other sect leaders wanted to ask for a piece so that they could properly study it. But when they thought about how the World Business Alliance might not let them go, they gave up in the end. It would be better to ask Luo Zheng for help in the future. The sect leaders were thinking about how to ask Luo Zheng for a price.

Chapter 504
Cui Xie had withdrawn from the competition, he had given up on the Rising Dragon Arena.
However, there were still many sects and independent warriors on the scene, and none of them had given up on the Rising Dragon Arena.
Shi Kefan smiled. "The two men brought by Cui Xie have been eliminated. The rest of the competition will continue as planned, but the arena has been destroyed …" After saying that, Shi Kefan nodded his head at Yan Yueshan.
After that, Yan Yueshan left the scene of the Martial Dao Competition. But not long after that, the crowd heard steady footsteps approaching.
"Plop, plop …"
Everyone looked in the direction of the voice and saw Yan Yueshan using his fat body to forcefully carry the huge arena over.
The arena was about 60 meters wide, and in order to withstand the force of a Divine Core warrior, it was made with a very complicated process. Some of the materials used were even heavier than iron, and the weight of the entire arena was incredibly high. But, Yan Yueshan was able to withstand the weight of the arena with just his shoulders.
"Clang!"
Following an earth-shattering boom, Misty Yue Mountain covered the entire arena.
All the Sect Lords didn't have much of a reaction when they saw this. Most of the Void Tribulation warriors on the scene could do the same, but the warriors on the spectator stands were all cheering and praising Yan Yueshan.
With different thoughts in their minds, all the Sect Lords returned to their respective stands.
In fact, Luo Zheng's killing of Si Miaoling had fulfilled many people's wishes.
Although the few big sects had been enjoying a great reputation for the past few years, because of Cui Xie's sudden rise, all of them felt a deep sense of crisis. Even the World Business Alliance felt the same.
Now that Cui Xie was so powerful, it would often take two or three sects to join forces to restrain him. He had also expressed his ambition to establish a Divine Nation more than once or twice, but under such circumstances, the great sects could only pretend not to hear him.
If Cui Xie really set up the Heavenly Devil Joyous Union Formation and allowed him to break through to the Divine Sea realm, no one in the Central Domain would be able to stop Cui Xie. At that time, no matter if it was the Void Spirit Sect, the World Business Alliance, or the Cloud Hall, they would only have two choices.
They would either submit to Cui Xie, or be destroyed by Cui Xie.
From this point of view, no matter if it was Daoist Qing Xu from the Void Spirit Sect or the three Lords from the World Business Alliance, they would have to thank Luo Zheng.
However, all the pressure would have to be shouldered by Luo Zheng and the Cloud Hall.
On the high platform, Granny Yu's face was as cold as ever. The wrinkles on her face seemed to have been carved with a knife.
Granny's face.................................
.............. It's useless to be angry. If Cui Xie comes to us in the future, how can we deal with him? How was he going to explain this to everyone in the Cloud Palace? . To the millions of disciples of the Cloud Hall? "
The Cloud Hall alone couldn't fight against Cui Xie. As the number one person in the Central Domain, Cui Xie could completely defeat the entire Cloud Hall with his own strength.
Granny Jade was a Life and Death Realm expert, but she had only survived one Heavenly Tribulation. She didn't know if she could safely survive the next one. Moreover, Granny Jade herself wasn't Cui Xie's opponent. If Ning Yudie mastered the Empyrean Fairy Heart Sutra and crossed the "line between life and death" to become a Life and Death Realm expert, she might be able to contend against Cui Xie.
But how difficult was it to cross the line between life and death? It wasn't something that could be accomplished in a day or two!
How could Ning Yudie not understand her Master's words?
When she rushed out a moment ago, she had weighed the pros and cons in her heart. If she offended Cui Xie, what would happen to the Cloud Hall? In the end, her emotions prevailed. She stood in front of Luo Zheng without hesitation. As for whether protecting Luo Zheng was a good deal for the Cloud Hall, Ning Yudie no longer considered it.
Ning Yudie's expression was gloomy and full of guilt. "I'm sorry … Master, perhaps I really am not qualified for the position of Hall Master …"
Seeing Ning Yudie so guilty, Granny Yu also sighed. "Alas, I know you're temperamental, but your talent is top-notch. Not to mention other things, as long as you complete the 《Empyrean Fairy Heart Sutra》, you'll be able to challenge Life and Death Realm experts as a False Tribulation Realm expert. When you break through the Life and Death Realm in the future, you'll definitely lead the Cloud Hall to become a fifth-grade Sect. You might even promote the Cloud Hall to become a Holy Land …"
If a sixth-grade Sect didn't contend for hegemony, it could become a Holy Land. If it contended for hegemony and established a Martial Artist's Nation, it would be called a Divine Nation. The Cloud Hall didn't have the heart to contend for hegemony. Being able to become a Holy Land was already a supreme honor.
At this moment, Luo Zheng suddenly said with a serious expression, "Granny Yu, I have a way to deal with Cui Xie."
Granny Yu looked at Luo Zheng with a sarcastic expression. "Do you think that just because you killed someone in front of Cui Xie, he can't do anything to you? If it weren't for the World Business Alliance stopping him, I'm afraid you'd have turned into dust by now! If a Martial Artist doesn't have his own strength and relies on luck, he can't do this a second time! "
"Luck is also a kind of strength. Granny Yu, can you let me finish speaking?" Luo Zheng asked.
"Speak," Granny Yu said indifferently. Granny Yu didn't have a good impression of this brat Luo Zheng. This brat's sister had been kidnapped, and he dared to blame it on Ning Yudie. He was just a Divine Reflection Stage junior, yet he dared to bully her disciple. How could Granny Yu tolerate this?
However, Granny Yu could also see that Ning Yudie seemed to have feelings for him. She was biased towards Luo Zheng in every matter, so Granny Yu couldn't do anything to Luo Zheng. What's more, Granny Yu could see that Luo Zheng had great luck. Granny Yu was a person who had crossed the line between life and death. How could she not see Luo Zheng's luck?
Among Martial Artists, luck was a very strange thing.
It was very difficult for those with great luck to die, and they could even swallow the luck of others. When a group of people took risks in a hopeless situation, the person with the strongest luck could swallow the luck of others. Therefore, in the adventure, everyone else would suffer, and only the person with great luck would survive, obtain all kinds of treasures, and safely escape danger …
Granny Yu was afraid that Luo Zheng's luck would be too strong and swallow the luck of the entire Cloud Hall, causing harm to the Cloud Hall.
How could Luo Zheng know what Granny Yu was thinking? He just said, "I want to abstain from the Martial Arts Conference."
"Why?" The deep wrinkles on Granny Yu's forehead twisted, and she stared intently at Luo Zheng.
In fact, the results of this Martial Arts Conference were gradually becoming clear. The biggest suspense was probably between Luo Zheng and Little Jie. However, there was still a female disciple by Nanhua Venerable's side who had been masked from beginning to end. Until now, she hadn't made a move, so perhaps there was also suspense.
But in any case, Luo Zheng had a great chance to compete for first place.
Ning Yudie's slender eyebrows also rose, and she looked at Luo Zheng with a complicated gaze.
"I want to help the Cloud Hall build the Sect Protecting Array," Luo Zheng said slowly.
The Rising Dragon Stage was important to Luo Zheng, but only he held the secret of the Rising Dragon Stage. To put it bluntly, whoever entered the Rising Dragon Stage would be entering a dead end. Not only would they not be able to obtain any benefits, but they would also be imprisoned for a thousand years. This was no joke. For most people, a thousand years was no different from a death sentence.
"Sect Protecting Array …" Granny Yu's expression changed.

"Are you sure you can set up a Great Array to resist Cui Xie?" Granny Yu asked.

Qinglong was able to set up the Great Thousand Treasure Array, a wondrous array that could destroy heaven and earth. A mere fourth-grade Sect's Great Array was only used to resist a Life and Death Realm expert, so it shouldn't be a problem for him.
Granny Yu had lived for so many years, so what couldn't she see through?
She nodded slightly, "In that case, there's no need to hesitate. If you want to set up the Sect Protecting Array, all the materials and costs will be paid by the Cloud Hall!"
Hearing Granny Yu's words, Luo Zheng muttered in his heart, 'Isn't this nonsense? I'll help you set up the Sect Protecting Array, so if you don't provide the materials, who will? ' This old woman's words were really … Of course, he didn't dare to say this out loud.

Chapter 505

Chapter 506

A Sect-Protecting Formation often took a year or even a few years to complete. It was not something that could be completed in a day or two. Why was there a need to be in such a hurry?
"Not in a hurry?" Luo Zheng chuckled. "If you're not in a hurry, perhaps Cui Xie will come tomorrow …"
Luo Zheng's words made Zong Rui a little dizzy. Let alone Cui Xie coming tomorrow, even if it was a month later, the Sect-Protecting Formation would not be completed!

Chapter 507
Drawing a Great Sect Protection Formation was far more difficult than the one Luo Zheng had drawn in the arena that day.
A Great Sect Protection Formation needed a formation that could protect the entire sect. No matter how small a sect was, it was still many times bigger than a stage.
For example, taking the Blue Cloud Sect as an example, the size of the entire Blue Cloud Sect was almost comparable to the Burning Heaven Imperial Capital!
However, the Cloud Hall was a special case.
After all, the entire Cloud Hall had been separated from its foundation and was floating in the sky.
Even though it was built on a huge floating rock, there was a limit to the size of the floating rock. Therefore, as a fourth-rank sect, the Cloud Hall wasn't that big.
In addition to a defensive formation, it also needed a means of attack. A Great Sect Protection Formation couldn't just take a beating and not retaliate.
After leaving the Ice Palace, Zong Rui retrieved the measurement data of the entire Cloud Hall. Then, Luo Zheng floated above the Cloud Hall and looked around before slowly descending.
"How many divine runes are needed for this Great Sect Protection Formation?" Luo Zheng asked. The person he was asking was naturally Qinglong in his mind.
"Hehe, if it's a Nine-Star Divine Rune, only one is needed," Qinglong replied.
Luo Zheng rolled his eyes. A Nine-Star Divine Rune, wouldn't it only take one to destroy the entire Central Domain?
Not to mention that Qinglong couldn't draw a Nine-Star Divine Rune, even if he could, Luo Zheng couldn't find the materials.
"However, the Cloud Hall isn't that big. I've estimated that if it's a three-star and four-star divine rune, you'll need about four thousand nine hundred of them. Among them, you'll need three five-star divine runes. The key is that you need to find enough materials," Qinglong said seriously.
Luo Zheng nodded. "Materials are the first problem to be solved."
After a rough estimate, Luo Zheng began to list out the materials. He found a table and started waving the pen in his hand. According to the information provided by Qinglong, he listed out the materials one by one.
"Earth-Shattering Rhino Horns, twenty!"
"Purple Field Wood, four!"
"Wu Chen Incense, two hundred coins …"
"Golden Threaded Leaf …"
"…"
"…"
Lists after lists of materials were listed. Zong Rui's scalp went numb as he looked at them.
Although Ning Yudie had made it very clear that she was only assisting Luo Zheng in the construction of the Sect Protecting Great Array, the price of each material was sky-high, and they were very difficult to find. If she wanted to get them in a short period of time, she would have to pay double or even triple the price to buy them.
Seeing Zong Rui holding the list of materials and unable to take a step forward, Luo Zheng asked curiously, "What's wrong?"
"The things on this list …" Zong Rui muttered as he pointed at the materials on the list.
"You can't buy them?" Luo Zheng frowned and asked. He was afraid that some materials were too rare and couldn't be purchased.
"I can buy it, but isn't it too expensive?" Zong Rui made a rough calculation. Just this list alone had used a lot of top-grade true essence stones. "If I buy all these materials, I'm afraid it will consume nearly half of the Cloud Hall's savings!"

"Nonsense!" Zong Rui said.

About one-third of the materials were stored in the Cloud Hall itself, and the other one-third were scattered in the Cloud Sea City and the five major Sects under the Cloud Hall. After Zong Rui passed the order, the five second-grade Sects under the Cloud Hall continuously transported the materials to the Cloud Hall.
As for the last one-third of the materials, Zong Rui could only personally lead people to purchase them from the World Business Alliance.
Every time he obtained a material, Luo Zheng would use a thick brush to tick it off on the list. Gradually, more and more ticks were added to the list.
Three days later, all the materials on the list were ticked off. In other words, all the materials had been gathered.
After gathering these materials, Luo Zheng temporarily borrowed Zong Rui's place.
Just like Tower Master Nie and the others of the Runic Tower, Rune Masters had very high requirements for the environment. Zong Rui's place was set up on the side of the Cloud Hall. One could see the rolling sea of clouds from outside the empty hall. The environment was very good.

According to Qinglong's design, this sect protecting array had a total of 4901 runes. The rune that Luo Zheng drew was only a three-star rune.
The instant Luo Zheng's rune pen touched the rune paper, his Soul Strength quickly activated the properties of the material in the ink. It blossomed with a fiery red light. This rune was a fire attribute offensive rune!
The tip of the brush gently danced on the paper like a stream of fire, continuously painting the surface of the paper. Those runes were like blossoming flames.
Seeing Luo Zheng casually draw perfect strokes, he was also dumbfounded.
Inside the Cloud Hall, if there was someone who was the happiest, it would be Zong Rui. Zong Rui's talent and talent weren't weak. In terms of martial talent, he could be considered as a Heavenly rank genius. However, he had been immersed in the Dao of Runes all his life, and that was why he was still a Divine Core warrior. Luo Zheng didn't stand up, he just nodded his head. An assistant immediately took the rune away and placed it on the side of the hall, waiting for the ink on the paper to dry.
After that, the second rune, the third rune …
For 12 hours, Luo Zheng maintained the same posture. The Rune Brush in his hand didn't stop for a single moment.
During the first hour, Zong Rui asked Luo Zheng if he needed to rest, but Luo Zheng shook his head and continued drawing.
Zong Rui didn't expect this guy to draw continuously for 12 hours!
Drawing a rune would consume a lot of soul energy. Although a Rune Master's soul was stronger than an ordinary warrior's, what did it mean to draw a rune for 12 hours?
Zong Rui's skill in Runes could be ranked amongst the best in the Central Domain. He had once studied in the Runic Tower, and when he left the Runic Tower, his soul energy was ranked within the top 10. Even so, after drawing five runes in a row, he felt dizzy, and needed to rest for a few days before he could continue drawing runes!
This was why Zong Rui thought it would take at least a year, or even a few years, to set up a Sect Protecting Formation! Drawing runes wasn't like drawing graffiti. The problem was that Luo Zheng looked no different from drawing graffiti. It was as if he could draw runes at his fingertips!
Zong Rui naturally didn't know how strong Luo Zheng's soul was. He simply couldn't imagine that a Divine Reflection Realm kid actually had the soul of a Battle Soul!
After continuously inscribing for twelve hours, Luo Zheng finally felt a trace of exhaustion. This was a sign that he had overexerted his Spiritual Force. Hence, he stopped inscribing Divine Inscriptions. In the corner of the hall, over two hundred 3-star Divine Inscriptions were neatly arranged.

This kid's soul must be made of iron!

At this time, the temperature in the hall dropped slightly. Ning Yudie floated in. The assistants and deacons shuttling back and forth in the hall all saluted the Palace Lord. Ning Yudie waved her hand slightly, indicating that they shouldn't disturb Luo Zheng.
Her eyes, which were as warm as the sun, glistened like a tranquil valley. With a refreshing classical charm, she quietly gazed at Luo Zheng.
However, Luo Zheng didn't seem to notice. He was only focused on waving the tip of his brush, immersed in the world of runes.

The Ice Phoenix quickly rushed out of the ice palace. As it collided with Ning Yudie, it began to crack. Ice crystals turned into armor that tightly wrapped her petite body. At the same time, the Profound Ice Halberd also appeared in Ning Yudie's hands.
Once Cui Xie broke the barrier, everyone in the Cloud Hall couldn't just sit still and wait for death.
Only Luo Zheng stood behind the barrier. Facing Cui Xie, who was about to attack, he didn't move.
＝＝＝＝＝

Chapter 514
Luo Zheng was well aware of his own strength.
In terms of runes, no one in the Central Domain could surpass him. The runes passed down from the upper realm were not something the runes of the Central Domain could compare with.
However, in terms of strength, in front of these False Tribulation Realm elders, Ning Yudie, Life and Death Realm Granny Yu and Cui Xie, he was just an ant in the Radiant Spirit Realm.
In a battle between Life and Death Realm experts, even the False Tribulation Realm elders were considered cannon fodder. Perhaps only Ning Yudie could barely help Granny Yu, while Luo Zheng could not even be considered cannon fodder.
Therefore, it was meaningless whether Luo Zheng resisted or not.
The surging Yuan Qi of Heaven and Earth continuously poured into Cui Xie's tall and sturdy body. At this moment, Cui Xie seemed to have turned into a mountain. This mountain-like man's eyes flickered slightly as he punched the air.
"Firmament Shattering!"
"Rip!"
From Luo Zheng's point of view, Cui Xie's entire body seemed to be somewhat distorted. Under the pressure of his punch, the space seemed to be about to be torn apart!
A huge fist light rushed towards Luo Zheng. Within this fist light, there seemed to be an extremely domineering momentum!
"Is this the 'momentum' that can shatter everything?"
Luo Zheng's eyes flickered as he stared at the fist light that was rapidly approaching him.
Almost in an instant, the fist light hit Luo Zheng on the boundary less than a meter away from Luo Zheng.
At this moment, Luo Zheng felt like he was about to suffocate.
"Boom!"
It was as if millions of firecrackers exploded at the same time. The huge roar was deafening!
This was because the fierce wind caused by the fist light even produced countless wind blades that scattered in all directions. Some of the wind blades even rebounded onto Cui Xie's body. However, Cui Xie did not dodge at all. Those wind blades only cut through Cui Xie's robes and did not cause any harm to him.
Even the residual power of this punch was enough to kill Luo Zheng.
However, Luo Zheng did not suffer the slightest bit of impact. The Abundant Water Light steadily blocked all the power outside.
In order to neutralize the impact of the punch, the surface of the Abundant Light surged with monstrous waves. With the punch as the center, the waves swept in all directions. In the end, the force of the punch was evenly distributed across the entire surface of the barrier. Only then did the entire barrier slowly return to its original tranquility …
...... The Cloud Cloud Hall's eyes lit up.
Ning Yudie breathed a sigh of relief as her eyes narrowed into small crescents. Now, it seemed that her bet on Luo Zheng was not a loss.
Granny Yu still maintained her youthful appearance, and her expression did not change at all.
... of the Luo...
. A Sect Protecting Great Array that could block the strongest experts of the Central Domain. The value of this Great Array was simply immeasurable.
If a Life and Death Realm expert were to choose between Luo Zheng's Sect Protecting Great Array, both the Cloud Hall and the Void Spirit Sect would most likely choose this Great Array!
The reason was very simple. Although a Life and Death Realm expert could bring a Sect to the peak, even a Life and Death Realm expert's lifespan was limited. After a thousand or two thousand years, a Life and Death Realm expert would ultimately not be able to cross the threshold of life and death.
There were many withered bones in front of the Longevity Gate. In the Vast Thousand Domains, there were many people with long lifespans. Who could have an unlimited lifespan?
However, a Sect Protecting Great Array was not ordinary. As long as it was maintained well, it could almost last forever. If a Sect was protected from destruction, it would give birth to a super genius sooner or later!
Therefore, Ning Yudie did not suffer a loss, but made a huge profit!
Cui Xie also did not expect that his full strength punch would not be able to break the Barrier. At this moment, Cui Xie's face was filled with endless shock.
After roaming the Central Domain for so many years, it was very rare for something to shock him like this.
Only Cui Xie himself knew how powerful his punch was!
However, this seemingly thin layer of water bubble had blocked his punch. The strength of this Barrier had already exceeded Cui Xie's understanding.
The most infuriating thing was that Luo Zheng seemed to be very confident in this Barrier. He was actually standing two feet behind the Barrier with a dead fish expression, as if the words "What can you do to me" were written on his face!
Cui Xie had not been ridiculed like this for many years. He could not remember.
Ever since he had broken through to the Life and Death Realm, all the Sects in the Central Domain had either been attentive or polite to him. Even the fifth-grade Sect, the Void Spirit Sect, which had a conflict with him in the past, did not dare to offend Cui Xie.
This kid in front of him was really strange!
Obviously, this punch was not enough to make Cui Xie give up. Cui Xie was not willing to give up on his trip to the Cloud Hall because of a Sect Protecting Great Array.
This time, Cui Xie pulled out the nameless Buddhist Commandment Blade from his waist.
In Cui Yun's hands, this nameless Buddhist Commandment Blade was still unable to display its true power, because Cui Yun had been defeated by Luo Zheng. Cui Xie also understood some things. The path of a martial artist had to be walked by oneself. Even if his son had god-grade talent, he still had to temper himself and grow. Strength that relied on external forces was not true strength.
After Cui Xie grasped the nameless Buddhist Commandment Blade, his entire aura changed. Originally, Cui Xie gave people a feeling that he was as heavy as a mountain, but after holding the nameless Buddhist Commandment Blade, he instantly gave people a sharp aura!
It was as if he was the blade!
Sensing the aura emitted by Cui Xie, the faces of many False Tribulation Realm Elders once again revealed cautious expressions.
Although they had indeed blocked Cui Xie's punch, they did not know what kind of trump cards Cui Xie, a top expert, had!
Therefore, although they were confident in this barrier, they were still worried.
Only Luo Zheng did not move. He was still standing two feet below the barrier. Suddenly, he whispered, "Are you ready? Let's start! "
After putting some distance between them, Cui Xie held the nameless Buddhist Commandment Blade horizontally. The khaki-colored Quintessential Essence in his arm turned into silk threads and poured into the nameless Buddhist Commandment Blade.
"Condense!"
A khaki-colored blade shadow began to expand along with the nameless Buddhist Commandment Blade! From the nameless Buddhist Commandment Blade, a huge blade shadow that was three hundred feet long and four to five feet wide condensed!
Even if he did not activate the blade intent within such a huge blade shadow, just this blade shadow alone would be able to cut a small mountain in half. If he activated the blade intent within, he might be able to directly flatten a mountain.
The Life and Death Realm originally had the ability to topple mountains and overturn seas.
"Furious Void Slash!"
After brewing for a while, Cui Xie attacked again, waving the nameless Buddhist Commandment Blade.
The several dozen feet long blade shadow seemed to be able to cut the sky in half. In the Central Domain, there was probably nothing that could block this blade.
"Cha!"
This horizontal slash left a long and narrow blade mark on the surface of the Abundant Light. The end of the blade mark was where Luo Zheng was standing.
The barrier still did not break.
This huge blade mark indeed caused the entire barrier to shake. The huge waves on the surface were several dozen feet high. Unfortunately, Cui Xie's strength still did not exceed the barrier's limit.
After using this blade strike, even Cui Xie could not help but gasp for breath. His expression gradually turned gloomy. He really had no way to deal with Luo Zheng! This was a fact that Cui Xie did not want to admit no matter what.
Just as Cui Xie was thinking of other ways to break the barrier, a heavy sense of crisis suddenly rose in his heart.
In addition to cultivating several very overbearing cultivation methods, Cui Xie also had a very unique talent. It was this talent that allowed him to escape from danger in many situations. He could feel the killing intent of others towards him, and he could also sense the impending danger.
However, after entering the Life and Death Realm, Cui Xie did not have many opportunities to use this talent, because it was very difficult for anyone in the Central Domain to threaten his life.
However, at this moment, he actually felt a sense of danger.
Reflexively, his figure suddenly flew in a certain direction. At this time, he saw that a cloud of psychedelic colored smoke was actually spreading towards him.
Fortunately, Cui Xie's speed was very fast. He had already rushed out of the encirclement before the clouds of smoke could close in.
At the same time, another lightning bolt as thick as a dragon suddenly struck towards him.
"Crack!"
This dragon-like lightning bolt finally struck Cui Xie from the side and did not hit him.
However, Cui Xie could feel the power contained in this lightning bolt. If he had been hit, even if he had not died, he would have been seriously injured. Coupled with the psychedelic smoke, Cui Xie suddenly had a thought. The Sect Protection Array of the Cloud Hall had the ability to kill him.

Chapter 515
"What a pity." Luo Zheng sighed in his mind. After that, he told Zong Rui using his Divine Sense, "Zong Rui, you're too slow."
Zong Rui was troubled as well. Just now, he was hiding in the Cloud Hall, waiting for Luo Zheng's order to activate the Chaos Trap and carefully surround Cui Xie. After that, he would activate the Fury of Thunder Punishment.
The Chaos Trap was half illusion formation, and half killing formation. Once Cui Xie fell into the trap, he would be immersed in an endless illusion. At that time, the lightning from the Fury of Thunder Punishment would be able to hit Cui Xie directly.
He didn't expect Cui Xie to be so sensitive, and be able to sense the layers of killing intent before anyone else. That allowed him to escape from the Chaos Trap and avoid the lightning from the Fury of Thunder Punishment.
A Divine Core Rune Master and a Divine Reflection Warrior, both of them had worked together to kill the number one man in the Central Domain. If news of this were to spread out, it would be unbelievable.
What was even worse was that they had almost succeeded.
Perhaps the Chaos Trap couldn't kill Cui Xie, and the Fury of Thunder Punishment could only severely injure him. But, these False Tribulation warriors in the Cloud Hall didn't just stand there as punishment. Perhaps they were just cannon fodder when facing a Life and Death warrior, but if they all attacked together, Cui Xie might not be able to defend himself.
Besides, the Palace Master of the Cloud Hall was here, and Granny Yu, who was also a Life and Death warrior.
The group of Sect Elders who were trembling in fear because of Cui Xie also had regretful expressions on their faces.
Even the usually expressionless Granny Yu had a regretful expression on her face.
On the other side, Ning Yudie was sitting on top of the Profound Ice Halberd. Her fair and slender legs were slightly swinging, and her lips were pouting. She didn't say anything.
Cui Xie was able to grow until now because he had absorbed the luck of countless people. It wasn't easy to kill him.
After distancing himself from the Cloud Hall, Cui Xie's powerful heart was still beating violently. After dodging the attack of the Sect-Protecting Array of the Cloud Hall, Cui Xie felt a lingering fear.
If Cui Xie had really fallen into the trap, coupled with the fact that the Cloud Hall's people had swarmed him, he might have really lost his life. Cui Xie had not expected such a turn of events.
He'd licked the blood of blades all his life, and he'd grown tenaciously in all sorts of dangerous situations. He'd encountered countless dangers, but since he'd crossed the line between life and death, no one had brought him so close to death …
From the beginning to the end, that annoying brat had been standing at the edge of the barrier, looking at her with indifferent eyes.
This kid was really tricky to deal with.
He was only at the Divine Reflection realm, yet he had so many tricks up his sleeves. If this guy broke through to the Divine Core realm, or even the Void Tribulation realm, he would be a huge threat to her in the future!
Before this, Cui Xie wanted to kill Luo Zheng because he wanted to take revenge for Cui Yun and Si Miaoling's twin swords. But now, Cui Xie knew that Luo Zheng was an obstacle, a target he had to eliminate on his path to achieving his great vision!
While being vigilant, Cui Xie once again drew closer to Luo Zheng. "Luo Zheng, you're qualified to be my opponent."
Hearing this, all the Void Tribulation Elders in the Cloud Hall felt as if the blood in their heads had stopped flowing, and they felt dizzy!
A mighty warrior who had lived for several hundred years, who had crossed the line between life and death, was saying something like this to a teenage boy?
Luo Zheng was qualified to be Cui Xie's opponent? Not to mention Cui Xie, he wasn't even qualified to fight any of the Void Tribulation Elders here. With the overall strength of these Void Tribulation Elders, killing Luo Zheng in an instant was a piece of cake.
However, when Cui Xie said something like this, all the Void Tribulation Elders felt as if their eyes were going blind. How could the world be so strange?
Luo Zheng's expression didn't change at all. He suppressed his emotions and said with a cold voice, "Let Luo Yan go, and I'll spare your life."
"Gulp! Cough cough cough cough cough … "
An Elder swallowed his saliva with great difficulty, and nearly choked to death by his own saliva!
All the Elders' expressions were even more interesting …
Although Luo Zheng had given the Cloud Hall a lot of surprises, Luo Zheng had no idea how strong he was! Was he scared silly by Cui Xie's attack just now? Was he scared out of his wits? How could he start talking nonsense?
Even Grandma Yu's face was full of astonishment. How could she have thought that Luo Zheng would really dare to open his mouth?
Only Ning Yudie finally covered her mouth with her hand and giggled. This man was always so interesting, as if he didn't know what pressure was. Unfortunately, it seemed that he only had eyes for his little sister!
Luo Yan was Luo Zheng's most important relative. How could he become the opponent of Cui Xie, a mighty warrior of the Central Domain? Luo Zheng wasn't interested! For Luo Zheng, the Martial Dao was an endless path of thorns. He could only climb to the peak bit by bit, and Cui Xie was an obstacle that Luo Zheng had to overcome.
Suddenly hearing Luo Zheng's reply, Cui Xie was also stunned.
He, a mighty mighty warrior of the Central Domain, had suffered a loss at the hands of Luo Zheng today. He had some admiration in his heart. After all, Luo Zheng's attainments in runes were unheard of, which was why he said those words. As a result, this brat was simply too arrogant!
Cui Xie's face was a little embarrassed, and then he laughed out of anger. "Haha! Spare me? How ambitious! Don't worry about your little sister, ask yourself how long you can live first! I don't believe that you'll stay in the Cloud Hall for the rest of your life! "
Cui Xie couldn't break the Cloud Hall's Sect Protecting Array now, but what if he found another person with the Extreme Violet Yin Body? Cui Xie's strength would increase by leaps and bounds through the Great Heavenly Demon Orgy Array. At that time, the Cloud Hall might not be able to stop Cui Xie.
Luo Zheng glanced coldly at Cui Xie, left the edge of the barrier, and flew down. At the same time, he sent a voice transmission to Zong Rui, "Drive him away."
"Crackle …"
Under Zong Rui's control, the Wrath of Thunder Punishment sent bolts of lightning, which were as thick as a Thunder Tribulation, toward Cui Xie …
The Sect Protecting Array also needed the support of True Origin Stones. Every Thunder Tribulation required several top-grade True Origin Stones. However, Zong Rui didn't care about money. He controlled the array disc to send bolts of lightning toward Cui Xie. Cui Xie couldn't break the barrier, so he could only passively take the beating. He wanted to say a few more words, but Luo Zheng left directly. In the end, he had no choice but to leave in a sorry state.
However, Cui Xie didn't leave the Cloud Sea City directly. He had to vent his anger because of a little guy at the Divine Reflection Realm. Therefore, the Cloud Sea City suffered a calamity.
Standing on the high Cloud Hall, a cloud of dust suddenly rose from the edge of the Cloud Sea City.
The Cloud Sea City was also a big city. It was surrounded by a wall made of square bricks, which stretched for more than 100 miles around the city! Cui Xie directly entered the wall and circled the entire Cloud Sea City. The outer wall of the Cloud Sea City was peeled off by Cui Xie alone. At least several hundred people were killed or injured!
To Cui Xie, the people of the Cloud Sea City were all ants. Although he could destroy the entire Cloud Sea City to vent his anger, he really didn't have much interest in crushing ants. Moreover, Cui Xie hadn't been to the Slaughter Sword Mountain. If he slaughtered too many creatures, it would be troublesome if he was infected with a heavy baleful aura. He would also have to spend time to eliminate this baleful aura.
In the end, Cui Xie destroyed the wall and chose to leave …
After Cui Xie left, wrinkles slowly appeared on Granny Yu's young face. Then, her hair gradually turned white, and her back stooped. She returned to her old appearance.
Ning Yudie's figure fluttered, and she grabbed her master's arm. She giggled and said, "Master, you still look good like that!"
"You have no respect for your elders!" Granny Jade rolled her eyes. She controlled the Law of Life, which was why her True Essence had such an effect. It was able to rejuvenate a person. However, Granny Jade could also use a bit more True Essence to maintain her youthful appearance, but it wasn't necessary.
Now, the atmosphere in the Cloud Hall was relatively relaxed. After dealing with Cui Xie, the mountain that was pressing down on everyone's hearts had finally been removed.
Just now, when many elders appeared, the disciples of the Cloud Hall were actually secretly watching. When they saw Luo Zheng standing under the barrier and not dodging Cui Xie's attack, they all sighed in their hearts.
"What's so great about it? This barrier is so strong. Luo Zheng is just hiding behind it! There's no danger at all! "A Cloud Hall disciple said, unconvinced.
"First, this barrier was drawn by Luo Zheng. Second, not to mention just now, even if Cui Xie comes again, I dare not stand on it!" A Cloud Hall disciple next to him retorted.

Chapter 516
In the Central Domain, how many people dared to face Cui Xie directly?
Even Luo Zheng was unwilling to face Cui Xie directly. Only a fool would dare to provoke a Life and Death expert for no reason.
However, Luo Zheng had no other choice. Ever since Cui Xie took Luo Yan away, the conflict between him and Cui Xie was already irreconcilable. There was no room for reconciliation between him and Cui Xie.
Therefore, when Luo Zheng encountered Cui Xie, he said those shocking words. Since he knew that begging was useless, and that saving Luo Yan would ultimately depend on his own fists, he might as well be ruthless and fight to the death.
Perhaps, this was Luo Zheng's Dao.
After Cui Xie left, news of the Cloud Hall's Sect Protecting Great Formation quickly spread throughout the Central Domain.
A Sect Protecting Great Formation actually resisted Cui Xie's attack, and even had a chance to kill Cui Xie. This was simply unimaginable!
What did this mean? It meant that in the Central Domain, there was no sect or martial artist that could shake the Cloud Hall. If a sect war broke out, the Cloud Hall's losses would be minimal. At this moment, the Cloud Hall could already be considered as a quasi 5th grade sect!
A 4th grade sect finally changed its fate by relying on a rune master. Luo Zheng was destined to be recorded in the history of the Central Domain. At least now, everyone was certain that Luo Zheng's attainments in runes were much greater than Feng Guanyu's in history.
In these two or three days, in the restaurants of the major cities of the Central Domain, Luo Zheng could be heard everywhere.
"This time, Luo Zheng will probably become the most popular person in the Central Domain!"
"Hehe, even the half-dead Runic Tower is like Grandpa. Won't Luo Zheng become an ancestor in the future?"
"However, although his rune technique is powerful, Cui Xie is not to be trifled with. Once Luo Zheng leaves the Cloud Hall, he will die without the protection of the Sect Protecting Formation!"
In a bustling restaurant, Luo Zheng's matter was being discussed.
Suddenly, a martial artist with a tall stature slapped the table and said with a chuckle, "That might not be the case! Why don't you think about how monstrous Luo Zheng's talent is? He's able to defeat a Mid Divine Core warrior at the Divine Reflection realm! Didn't you hear what he said to the King of the East Evil? I'll spare your life! Haha, how much courage does it take to say that! "
"He's just hiding in that little tortoise shell. If it wasn't for the protection of the Sect Protecting Grand Formation, Cui Xie would be able to crush him with a single finger," another gloomy voice retorted.
"So what if I do? No matter what, I have high hopes for Luo Zheng! This young man is destined to amaze the world with a single brilliant feat, and his potential is limitless! "
All sorts of discussions and opinions were being held between all the martial artists, including those from the Cloud Hall.
At least for now, none of the people in the Cloud Hall treated Luo Zheng as a disciple of the Cloud Hall. They didn't even treat Luo Zheng as a deacon of the Cloud Hall, he was a figure comparable to an Elder!
Although Luo Zheng was the one who had brought Cui Xie back to the Cloud Hall, Luo Zheng had used his own strength to drive Cui Xie away. Who else in the Cloud Hall could do something like this?
Apart from this, there was another rumor that was being spread around. For example, some people believed that Luo Zheng was Ning Yudie's exclusive lover, and that both of them were having an affair … But, this rumor was only spread in private.
A few days later, the annual Lantern Lighting Festival arrived.
As night fell, the fiery red lanterns in the Cloud Sea City were lit up.
Groups of children carried small lanterns as they walked through the streets and alleys, bringing a little bit of light to every dark corner.
For ordinary people, this day was a lively festival. Apart from the small lanterns held by the children, the adults would release sky lanterns one after another. It was said that the sky lanterns could bring good luck in the coming year.
Since the evening, countless sky lanterns had risen into the sky. Some of the sky lanterns were blown by the wind and hit the huge barrier on the surface of the Cloud Hall, releasing gorgeous flames.
Apart from releasing sky lanterns, there was also the need to kill chickens and cows to entertain the guests with a feast. It was very lively.
However, for martial artists, this day was a bit special.
In the depths of the Central Domain's Cloud Dream Swamp, a thick fog drifted all year round. The swamp was rich in a special kind of Demonic Beast called the Cloud Swallowing Beast. The Cloud Swallowing Beast's Demonic Core could be made into a pill that could prolong one's life. Therefore, every year, countless martial artists would enter the Cloud Dream Swamp.
There were many great opportunities in the swamp. Every year, there would be martial artists who would obtain great benefits in the Cloud Dream Swamp, but at the same time, countless martial artists would die in the swamp.
A Divine Reflection warrior wasn't qualified to enter the swamp, and a Divine Core warrior was only allowed to go 300 miles into the swamp. Even a False Tribulation warrior could only go 800 miles into the swamp, and any deeper than that … even a False Tribulation warrior would have a chance of dying here. A thousand miles into the swamp was a place that no one could explore.
1500 miles away from the Cloud Dream Swamp, there were no records about this place, and it could no longer be described as an uninhabited place.
There was a huge black quagmire here. This quagmire was pure black, without any ripples. It was like a dead pond ….
Right at the edge of the black swamp, there was a small straw hut. Someone was actually living here! The straw hut was very simple, and the walls and roof were made of straw.
Not long after that, a short man walked out from the straw hut. This man was also a Life and Death warrior.
Within the Central Domain, there were only a handful of Life and Death warriors, and this man obviously wasn't one of them. He was a mighty warrior who lived in seclusion.
After he walked out from the straw hut, he looked at the darkening sky and murmured, "Is it the Lantern Lighting Festival again? I've lit this lantern 77 times … I wonder if my wish will come true this year. "
The Immortal Tomb Spirit Lantern would be lit during the Lantern Lighting Festival. 77 times, which meant 77 years …
After saying that, he took out an inconspicuous little oil lamp from behind his back and gently stroked it with his hand. After that, a devilish red flame appeared on the tip of his finger, and he gently rubbed it on the Immortal Tomb Spirit Lantern.
A faint yellow light bloomed from the flame.
Around the Immortal Tomb Spirit Lantern, there were nine tiny markings. Right now, six of them were lit up.
The Life and Death warrior looked at the six markings, and a faint smile emerged on his face. Nine markings, and one of them was useless …
Last year, eight markings had lit up. Would the last one light up this year?
In the World Business Alliance's headquarters, Shi Kefan, Yan Yueshan, and Mo Haishan had already gathered in an exquisite pavilion. An Immortal Tomb Spirit Lantern was placed in front of them, but they were still waiting for a certain someone.
After half an hour, the ancient magnate of the World Business Alliance slowly descended on the pavilion and said to Shi Kefan, "Light it. Also, gather the elders of our alliance while you're at it …"
Yan Yueshan looked astonished. "You mean that the ninth lantern this year …"
The ancient magnate nodded. "Yes, I've made some calculations. I have a strong premonition that the ninth lantern has already appeared, but I don't know who has it. That's why I asked you to send out invitations and do your best to help them light the lantern!"
"Then hurry up!" Yan Yueshan was an impatient person. He suddenly stood up and gently clapped his hands. A ball of flame shot toward the Immortal Tomb Spirit Lantern and steadily lit it up. At this moment, the seventh marking lit up on the Immortal Tomb Spirit Lantern.
The taciturn Mo Haishan nodded. "This year's speed is quite fast. Last year, the eighth marking only lit up at midnight. I almost thought that the person with the eighth lantern had given up …"
"I hope it can be done. I'll go gather the elders of the alliance," Shi Kefan said with a smile as he looked at the markings.
On a small island in the boundless South Sea, Cui Xie took out his Immortal Tomb Spirit Lantern and carefully examined it. He had already made preparations for this trip to the Immortal Tomb Spirit Lantern.
He sat on the top of a large tree on the island. Around the tree were six cloaked martial artists. These six were mid-stage and late-stage False Tribulation experts. They were willing to follow Cui Xie to their deaths and assist him in his great cause of establishing a Divine Nation!
Therefore, Cui Xie had to bring them along for this trip to the Immortal Tomb Spirit Lantern …
However, Cui Xie wasn't sure if the last lantern would be lit up. Now, he was focused on slowly lighting up his small oil lamp. The eighth marking also lit up.
Cui Xie looked at the dim yellow markings on the small oil lamp and muttered, "I wonder if the last marking can be lit up?"

Chapter 517
The eight Spirit Lamps of the Immortal Graveyard were in the hands of different forces in the Central Region. Apart from confirming that Cui Xie and the General Commerce League each had one Spirit Lamp of the Immortal Graveyard, the martial artists in the Central Region knew nothing about the other six Spirit Lamps. It was possible that the Blood Wood Cliff had the Spirit Lamp of the Immortal Graveyard, or even that the owner of the Spirit Lamp of the Immortal Graveyard was not in the Central Region!
But no matter what, the people who held the lamps hoped that the last lamp would be lit tonight.
On a platform at the edge of the Cloud Palace, Ning Yudie stood on it, watching the sky lanterns flutter in the sky, like small stars flickering in the night sky.
The elders of the Cloud Hall had already received the news the day before that the last Immortal Tomb Spirit Lamp had fallen into the hands of Ning Yudie.
This news shocked the elders greatly. They didn't expect that after waiting for so many years, the last lamp would be in the Cloud Hall!
The Heaven Mist Immortal Tomb was a great opportunity for the warriors in the Central Domain!
The treasures and opportunities hidden in the Tomb of the Immortals filled the hearts of many warriors with fanciful thoughts. This was also the reason why so many warriors went to the Chaotic Astral Ocean, wanting to sneak in from outside the Tomb of the Immortals. However, so far, tens of thousands of warriors had lost their lives in the Chaotic Astral Ocean, but none of them had succeeded.
The only way to enter the Immortal Tomb was the Immortal Tomb's Spirit Lamp.
Of course, with the appearance of the Immortal Tomb's Spirit Lamp, all kinds of conspiracy theories were born.
Some people thought that the Immortal Tomb's Spirit Lamp was a big trap. Otherwise, why would the Heaven Mist Immortal leave nine lamps for outsiders to enter?
Luo Zheng also suspected this before.
But for warriors, opportunities always coexisted with risks. Warriors who were afraid of the slightest thing couldn't grow at all. Everything in the world was like this!
After the elders in the Cloud Hall discussed, a total of six elders decided to enter the Immortal Tomb. Their reasons were different.
For example, Mister Zhuo was a powerful and relatively young elder. Naturally, he wanted more opportunities and opportunities.
Take Elder Fei Han as an example. He was already old, and his lifespan was nearing its end. If he was unable to break through, he would eventually fall in front of the Longevity Gate …
The other elders all had their own reasons.
This time, Granny Yu also decided to go to the immortal tomb. She had the same reason as Elder Fei Han, and was even more urgent than Elder Fei Han. As a Life and Death expert, she had to face a life and death calamity. If there were no accidents, she would definitely not be able to survive the second life and death calamity and was destined to fall!
Granny Yu's only choice was to place her hopes on the legendary Life-Death Flower.

Chapter 543

Chapter 544
In the pastures of humans, cattle and sheep were animals. Cattle and sheep were raised in the pastures, and only when they grew fat would they be slaughtered for food.
