According to the rules of the Sin Tower, the fastest way to level up was one month. From the first day one stepped into the Sin Tower, no one dared to challenge them!
In the past, there were a few creatures who used a month to reach the tenth floor, but they were all War Reverends.
Some geniuses from other races, for some reason, stayed in seclusion in their Sacred Lands and only chose to enter the Sin Tower after reaching the War Reverend level.
From the first floor to the fifth floor, there were Warriors, and from the sixth to the tenth floor, there were Generals.
Unless one met a War Reverend who was also trying to break through, naturally no one would challenge a War Reverend. After a month of being empty, one could reach the tenth floor as quickly as possible.
As for a War Reverend wanting to reach the tenth floor in a month, it was very unlikely because Purple Jade would encounter a War Reverend who was also trying to break through. Regardless of whether these War Reverends could defeat Purple Jade or not, they would have to delay her for a day!
Encountering a War Reverend was one thing, but this was the rule. That was why Purple Jade had given herself an extra fifteen days to deal with these blind idiots.
The problem was …
This guy in front of her was a Warrior, an eighth rank Warrior! And he was from the human race!
Since when did a cowardly human race have the courage to challenge her noble Demon Night Clan?
Purple Jade's beautiful eyes revealed endless killing intent. This killing intent, coupled with her almost perfect face, made people feel both moved and fearful. The two different feelings formed a sharp contrast, giving everyone a very special feeling!
"As expected of a near-perfect race. Every woman in the Demon Night Clan is a first-rate beauty." Luo Zheng slowly drew his sword.
"Sacred Artifact?" Purple Jade's slender eyebrows twitched, "Since when did your Purple Heart Holy Lands become so extravagant, giving a Sacred Artifact to a Warrior?"
"Xiu!" Luo Zheng lightly waved his sword and smiled, "I'm not from the Purple Heart Holy Lands."
Purple Jade coldly smiled, "I don't care who you are. Howl for me!"
She stood on tiptoe like a female leopard and suddenly rushed out. The Vital Spirit in her body bloomed with a faint light, leaving behind a graceful shadow in the arena.
"Very agile." Luo Zheng smiled faintly and gently twisted his long sword. It was still the Basic Swordsmanship!
After Luo Zheng's constant practice of the Basic Swordsmanship, the sword moves seemed to be slowly evolving.
This basic sword technique had been created after countless efforts by the predecessors. Through Luo Zheng, it had been further simplified to the extreme. However, the extreme simplicity was not the end!
Luo Zheng had a vague realization. He wanted to make the basic swordsmanship complex!
Going from complex to simple was a kind of evolution, and going from simple to complex was another kind of evolution!
A true grandmaster was able to create their own ultimate skills. No matter what level of cultivation method it was, it wasn't something that came from a stone but was created by a living being. Even a transcendent divine might was the same.
Luo Zheng was very clear that as long as he walked down this path, he would eventually be able to create his own unique skill!
"Ding!"
Luo Zheng's response was extremely fast. Facing Purple Jade's close-range attack, he used his sword to completely block her attack.
Luo Zheng didn't retreat. Instead, he used his sword to block Purple Jade's dagger. Then, Luo Zheng took advantage of this opportunity and rushed forwards!
Purple Jade was immediately confused.
Her speed was clearly fast! Let alone a human warrior, even a human general would be sent flying backwards by the impact of her attack even if they used a saint artifact to block it. But Luo Zheng was like a mountain, steadily standing in front of her and blocking her attack with his simple and crude sword skills!
Luo Zheng had a light smile on his face.
Purple Jade's strength should be greater than the Void Spirit Sect's Little Jie's. Her bodily strength and explosive power, as well as the innate advantages of her race, were far greater than Little Jie's. However, Purple Jade's comprehension of Laws was much lower. This was also because she was a body transformation cultivator!
"Wild Storm Stab!"
She was originally prepared to send Luo Zheng flying and then cut off Luo Zheng's flesh piece by piece! The more miserable he was, the more she would be able to intimidate those idiots in the Tower of Sin. Otherwise, if she couldn't obtain an empty stage, she didn't know when she would be able to reach the tenth level!
Facing Luo Zheng's crude sword skills, Purple Jade's dagger was like a raging storm, instantly stabbing out countless times!
"Sword Hanger." Luo Zheng faintly smiled. His sword moved horizontally, completely sealing himself from top to bottom.
Ding ding ding ding ding ding …
A series of crisp and pleasant sounds could be heard as the dagger and sword clashed countless times in an instant.
The thin three foot long sword was like an airtight shield that blocked in front of Luo Zheng!
"Ding!"
Purple Jade's explosive power was also limited. Whether it was vital essence or physical strength, they weren't as long lasting as vital essence. After a short burst, Luo Zheng's sword once again crushed Purple Jade's dagger. Luo Zheng lightly pressed down, and the two still maintained an "intimate" distance.
The tips of their noses were almost touching …
Purple Jade's chest heaved up and down. Her Wild Storm Stab could instantly deal a fatal blow to her opponent. Once Purple Jade used this move, it was practically a death sentence! Purple Jade once had a powerful opponent who was a rank eight battle general!
It was after Purple Jade used this move that the rank eight battle general was directly torn to pieces by her dagger. There wasn't a single piece of intact flesh on his body!
However, this human warrior in front of her actually used a sword to block all her attacks!
"How is this possible?" Purple Jade's eyes were filled with horror, and it was even a little flustered.
The members of the Demon Night Clan were originally very slender. With her boots on, she was slightly taller than Luo Zheng. "Wild Storm Stab" consumed a lot of physical strength. As she breathed heavily, her fragrant breath directly blew on Luo Zheng's face.
Luo Zheng, on the other hand, was still looking at her with that zombie-like face!
"It's indeed quite ruthless." Luo Zheng smiled faintly.
"You're mocking me!"
Purple Jade gritted her teeth and suddenly exerted force with her dagger. The short blade of the dagger pulled along the edge of Luo Zheng's long sword, and fierce sparks blossomed under the pull of the two weapons.
Whoosh!
A sharp and ear-piercing sound rang out. Then, like a snake, she wrapped around Luo Zheng's side.
In close combat, short weapons had a greater advantage than long weapons, so Purple Jade didn't plan to pull away from Luo Zheng.
However, just as Purple Jade wrapped around Luo Zheng's side and was about to stretch out her slender arms to wrap around Luo Zheng's neck, Luo Zheng lowered his head slightly.
If Purple Jade really did wrap around Luo Zheng's neck, then she would stuff the dagger into his neck. Although Luo Zheng believed that he was stronger than Purple Jade, he wouldn't be arrogant!
Because of Luo Zheng's gentle turn, the cub missed. Then, Luo Zheng turned around and blocked the cub's attack with his long sword, slashing horizontally at the cub's upright buttocks.
Seeing this scene, Fei 'er immediately panicked. She even covered her mouth and screamed.
On the spectator stands, a member of the Demon Night Clan suddenly stood up. He was a war sovereign of the Demon Night Clan!
As a god-tier genius of the Demon Night Clan's sacred land, Purple Jade naturally couldn't be allowed to enter the Tower of Sin alone. Thus, there were elders of the Demon Night Clan watching over her.
According to the war sovereign's estimation, Purple Jade's strength should allow her to pass through the first nine floors of the Tower of Sin without any trouble. As for the human kid in front of him …
Although the war sovereign found it strange that there was a female of the same clan following him, Luo Zheng was just a warrior! Humans were weak to begin with. Even a rank-10 warrior wasn't Purple Jade's match, let alone a mere warrior. Naturally, he wasn't worried.
However, he didn't expect the battle to be so one-sided. Thus, when he saw Luo Zheng slashing at Purple Jade's butt, the war sovereign's mind went blank. With the sharpness of Luo Zheng's holy weapon, Purple Jade would probably be cut in half. If Purple Jade died, how was he going to explain it to the elders of the Demon Night Clan?
The other creatures in the spectator stands also had very rich expressions on their faces.
Most of them couldn't believe what they were seeing!
The human race had always been weak on the Sea God Continent, but a prodigy of this level had actually appeared. They wondered if they were seeing things. Luo Zheng was clearly a human warrior!
Slap!
Luo Zheng's sword suddenly turned slightly and hit the cub's buttocks with the blade.

Chapter 563
Luo Zheng was very clear about his goal.
His first goal in the Tower of Sin was to cultivate, and his second goal was to obtain the inheritance beneath the Tower of Sin.
The Demon Race and the Demon Night Clan were both top clans on the Sea God's Continent, while the Human Race seemed to be extremely weak on this continent. As soon as Luo Zheng arrived on the Sea God's Continent, he had already formed a grudge with the Demon Race. Naturally, he wasn't stupid enough to form a deadly grudge with the Demon Night Clan.
Although Luo Zheng had used his sword to hit the cub, the force behind the blow was still very strong. The cub, who was hit on the butt by Luo Zheng, stumbled forward, looking very embarrassed.
The Demon Night Clan had always been arrogant and elegant, so how could they allow themselves to be humiliated in front of so many people? The moment the cub fell to the ground, it stretched out its hand and agilely pushed against the ground like some kind of reptile. Then, it flipped over, intending to counterattack!
Whoosh!
However, Luo Zheng's movements were very fast.
The long sword was already pressed against the cub's snow-white neck, and the tip of the sword hummed slightly. As long as Luo Zheng raised his hand, with the sharpness of the sacred weapon, the cub's head would fall to the ground.
Although the cub was angry and embarrassed, it didn't lose its mind. Before coming to the Tower of Sin, it had already understood the rules countless times!
In the Holy Land, it was the pride of the heavens. Who dared to take its life? However, in the arena, no one could protect it. Although the Demon Night Clan had many seats in the Tower of Sin, the rules set by so many clans couldn't be changed for a god-tier genius like itself.
If she was killed by Luo Zheng, the Demon Night Clan would avenge her, but in the end, she was already dead!
"Admit defeat, and I won't take your life." Luo Zheng's expression was already calm. It wasn't that he didn't know how to be protective of the fairer sex, but in this place, if he was careless, Luo Zheng could be killed by the cub. Luo Zheng was already giving her a lot of face by sparing her life.
"I … admit defeat," the cub said after recognizing the situation in front of it, even though its face was full of resentment.
Then, the Light of Creation in the cub's nameplate suddenly shot into Luo Zheng's nameplate.
The Light of Creation was a reward for the victor, and the amount of Light of Creation one had depended on the amount of Light of Creation one's opponent had.
Purple Jade was a warlord, so those who dared to challenge Purple Jade were at least warlords. Therefore, Luo Zheng obtained ten times more Light of Creation than before!
Having a high cultivation base also had its benefits. Just like when Luo Zheng had just entered the first floor of the Tower of Sin, those who dared to challenge Luo Zheng were all warriors. However, those warriors hadn't accumulated much Light of Good Fortune to begin with, so the points they obtained were pitifully few.
The cub glared fiercely at Luo Zheng and stepped out of the arena.
At this moment, Fei-er also breathed a sigh of relief. She hadn't expected Luo Zheng to walk into the arena for so long …
Although Fei-er had seen Luo Zheng's escape speed and was able to escape from three warlords of the Demon Race, which was considered incredible among warriors, she couldn't estimate Luo Zheng's true strength. Although Fei-er didn't treat Luo Zheng as an ordinary warrior, she didn't expect Luo Zheng to be so strong.
There was another round of whispers in the audience.
"No wonder Lord Moon Guardian told us not to throw our lives away. Although this guy is a human warrior, he can even defeat a warlord of the Demon Night Clan!"
"Is he only a warlord of the Demon Night Clan? Hehe, that woman from the Demon Night Clan is a god-level genius from the Demon Night Clan's Holy Land. She can't be treated as an ordinary warlord! But even so, she was still defeated by that human warrior! "
"Aren't humans more difficult to deal with when they reach the warlord or warlord realm? When did the Purple Heart Holy Land nurture such a super genius? "
"He just said that he didn't come from the Purple Heart Holy Land …"
"If this guy is allowed to fight his way through floor by floor, I'm afraid the human race will really have one more seat!"
All kinds of discussions revolved around Luo Zheng. All the races stared at Luo Zheng and whispered.

Hearing Luo Zheng's words, the crowd fell silent.
"Isn't there a famous beastman called Tito on the second floor? Where's Tito? Why don't I see him? "
"Are you kidding me? Tito is only a tenth-level warrior. Although he successfully defeated three warlords, he can't be Zi Yu's match, let alone this kid's match!"
"Those who know their limits won't dare to go up. That kid is willing to let the Demon Night Clan go, but that doesn't mean he'll let the other races go!"
Zi Yu had already intimidated everyone before. Now that Luo Zheng had defeated Zi Yu, this deterrence was actually strengthened. Who would dare to go up and seek death? Moreover, Luo Zheng's deeds on the first floor had already spread to the second floor. Who would dare to seek death now?
After a long while, no one dared to step up. No one challenged Luo Zheng, which meant that Luo Zheng had won the first day. For three consecutive days, Luo Zheng could advance freely!
Luo Zheng was quite satisfied with this result.
As for Zi Yu from the Demon Night Clan, she was quite dissatisfied.
Zi Yu walked out of the arena angrily, and the warlord from the Demon Night Clan hurriedly followed her.
When had Zi Yu ever suffered such a huge setback and humiliation?
Even in the Demon Night Clan's Sacred Land, where geniuses were everywhere, she was still one of the best!
Not to mention that the opponent she had lost to was not just a human, but a human fighter as well. If it were not for the fact that her martial heart was extremely tough, someone else would have probably suffered a devastating blow.
"I … I must kill him!" Zi Yu shouted angrily.
"This human kid is not simple. You're not his match right now." The warlord from the Demon Night Clan was very calm.
"I don't care! If ordinary methods can't kill him, then I'll use Heavenly Execution! "Zi Yu said coldly.
Hearing Zi Yu's words, the warlord from the Demon Night Clan's expression changed. He immediately said, "Zi Yu, don't do anything stupid. Heavenly Execution … can only be used as a last resort. Have you forgotten the elder's advice?"
"A last resort? It's a last resort now! "Zi Yu was very stubborn.
"Actually, you don't have to be so anxious. Since he entered the Sin Tower, he's naturally cultivating. You'll encounter him sooner or later. It won't be too late to challenge him when you're truly strong … There seems to be a woman from our Demon Night Clan by his side. I don't know which branch she's from, but I'll ask her about it first." The warlord from the Demon Night Clan was helpless and could only console Zi Yu like this.
"I'm truly strong?" Zi Yu was startled, but when she thought about it, the gloominess on her face grew even more intense. "That kid won't grow?"
That kid was able to defeat her when he was just a warrior. If he became a general, would she still be a match for him?
In truth, the warlord from the Demon Night Clan was well aware of this as well. However, in order to console Zi Yu, he could only advise her like this … But now, it seemed like his advice was useless. In the end, the warlord from the Demon Night Clan could only sigh in his heart. But that was fine as well. That kid didn't seem to want to kill Zi Yu.
Zi Yu was too arrogant, so it wasn't a bad thing for her to suffer a little setback in the Sin Tower. She could treat it as tempering her Martial Heart.
After Luo Zheng obtained the 'empty stage', he left the arena with Fei 'er following closely behind him.
Just like Zi Yu, Luo Zheng wanted to enter the higher levels of the Sin Tower as soon as possible. He wasn't interested in fighting the warriors, but the rules of the Sin Tower were as such, so Luo Zheng couldn't do anything about it.
This time, as soon as Luo Zheng arrived at the living area on the second floor, he saw many women on the side of the living area.
There were women from all sorts of races. Demons, beastmen, humans … There were even women from the Demon Night Clan!
All of these women wore revealing clothes and had seductive figures. They emitted the most primitive temptation.
"These women …" Luo Zheng glanced at them in confusion.
"Prostitutes," Fei 'er replied straightforwardly. "The pressure in the Sin Tower is very great, and all cultivators need to vent. It's very common to see them on the first floor to the tenth floor."
Luo Zheng pursed his lips. It was fine if they were from the human race and the Demon Night Clan, but there were also some from the beastmen and demons. With Luo Zheng's aesthetic standards, he naturally couldn't accept them.
Luo Zheng didn't stay here. Just as he was about to leave, a human woman walked out from the other side and blocked his path. She smiled at Luo Zheng and said, "Handsome, someone wants to talk to you."
The woman before him was a complete beauty. When he heard her, Luo Zheng smiled and asked, "How many true origin stones for a night?"

Chapter 564

Xia Shuang was very angry!

In the Central Domain and the four Divine Kingdoms, because the human race was powerful, there was internal strife, strife, and hatred.

Chapter 565
The Tower of Sin was an inverted tower with the top of the tower piercing deep into the ground.
To reach the bottom of the Tower of Sin, Luo Zheng had to reach the top of the Tower of Sin!
"What's at the top of the tower?" Luo Zheng suddenly asked.
Immortal Tian Miao had told Luo Zheng that there was an extremely important inheritance at the bottom of the Tower of Sin. For this inheritance, Immortal Tian Miao had even given up the right to use the Path of Reincarnation. There must be a shocking secret hidden within.
However, Luo Zheng still had no idea what it was.
"You don't know?" Lord Jing looked at Luo Zheng with a strange expression.
Many Sacred Grounds in the Sea God Continent had developed around the Tower of Sin. All the warriors in the Sea God Continent knew that if they wanted to reach a higher level, they had to enter the Tower of Sin! Only warriors who climbed to the top of the Tower of Sin would have the chance to stand at the top of the continent!
Even if Luo Zheng didn't come from the Purple Heart Sacred Ground, how could he not know anything about the Tower of Sin?

That Mysterious Underworld Cave is filled with an intense Mysterious Underworld Death Ray for most of the year! Even a Tenth Level War Reverend would die instantly after being hit by the Mysterious Underworld Death Ray! "
"Mysterious Underworld Death Ray? Killing a Tenth Level War Reverend in an instant! "Luo Zheng frowned.
In the Cursed Lands, the strongest warrior was a Tenth Level War Reverend. War Saints couldn't enter, otherwise, they would be cursed to death. Then, who else could enter the Mysterious Underworld Cave?
Lord Jing saw Luo Zheng's doubts and said, "Because of the Mysterious Underworld Death Ray, most of the time, no one can enter the Mysterious Underworld Cave. However, there's a month in a year when the Mysterious Underworld Death Ray will weaken greatly! Every year, at this time, all the races will enter the Tower of Sin to search for opportunities. "
There were two reasons why the Tower of Sin was important to the Sacred Grounds. Firstly, the Tower of Sin was an incubation base for warriors. As long as one's talent was strong enough, using the Light of Creation to increase one's cultivation would be a hundred times faster than outside! Secondly, the Mysterious Underworld Cave.
So far, the fortuitous encounters that the various Sacred Grounds had obtained in the Dark Nether Cave were unimaginable! Just like the human race's Purple Heart Holy Land, in fact, it was the human race's Purple Heart War Sovereign who obtained a seat in the Sin Tower and entered the Dark Nether Cave to obtain a great fortune!

"You must obtain a seat to enter the Xuanming Cave?" Luo Zheng asked.

"Our human race has four seats. That is to say, there are twenty seats in total?" Luo Zheng asked.
"That's right." Lord Jing nodded. "If you can enter the tenth level when the Xuanming Cave opens, we can consider giving you a spot."
Hearing Lord Jing's words, Luo Zheng's eyes brightened. He smiled and said, "Since that's the case, then I must thank Lord Jing."
Lord Jing shook his head, "Our human race has been weak for many years. We should help each other."
The truth was that these past years, the human race didn't lack powerhouses. On the contrary, the several old monsters of the Purple Heart Holy Lands were extremely strong. Otherwise, such a large Holy Land would have already been destroyed by the other races. The key point was that it had been a long time since a new powerhouse was born in the human race.
For instance, in the Monster Night Clan's Holy Land, there would be several martial artists like Purple Jade popping up every year. As for the human race, in these past ten years, they had only produced three martial artists with god-level talents, and one of them had perished in the Sin Tower …
If this situation couldn't be reversed, then once those old monsters reached the end of their lives and the new generation of martial artists couldn't keep up, the Purple Heart Holy Land would truly decline.
Just as they were talking, a thunderous laughter suddenly came from the entrance of the tavern. Two figures that were like small mountains walked directly into the tavern.
"Haha, I'm afraid the human race won't have any spots this year. Human brat, even if you thank us, it's useless!" The one who spoke was a Demon Race War Senior.
War Senior level powerhouses generally stayed on the eleventh to fifteenth floors. They rarely entered the lower floors. Even a human War Senior like Lord Jing came down to see Luo Zheng. The two Demon Race War Seniors in front of him had specifically come to the second floor for Luo Zheng.
"Yes, Mo Jie is right. The human race only has four spots. I don't know if they can keep their spots this year. That human brat called Ning Haoyu has been in seclusion, but no matter how long he has been in seclusion, it's useless. If he comes out, he'll be slapped to death by me, haha!" The other Demon Race War Senior sneered.
"Brat, why don't you join our Demon Race? Our Demon Race has twenty-two spots! With over a hundred spots, it'll be easy to bring you along! "The War Senior called Mo Xie laughed.
Lord Jing's expression became somewhat ugly.
Although there were conflicts between the various races in the Tower of Sin, they were usually settled in the arena. It was very rare for them to directly provoke each other like this. These two fellows were War Reverend level powerhouses. Their actions were too despicable and did not give them any face at all!
Although the human race was weak, they couldn't just let their prestige be destroyed in front of others and not fight back. Lord Jing was about to speak when Luo Zheng suddenly stood up.
He smiled and said, "Two War Seniors, does your Demon Race have a War General called Yue Shou?"
"Yes, he's the strongest genius of our Flame Demon Holy Land!" Mo Xie sneered.
"Not bad, Yue Shou is pretty good!" Luo Zheng praised.
Mo Xie continued to smile and said, "Nonsense, our Flame Demon Holy Land is full of geniuses. His talent can be promoted to number one, of course it's not bad."
"I'm not saying that his talent is good," Luo Zheng suddenly said with a serious face, "In your eyes, Yue Shou's talent is not bad, but in my eyes, it's not worth mentioning. I'm saying that Yue Shou's mentality is much stronger than yours. In any case, you are Demon Race War Seniors. Although you are only First Order Demon Race War Seniors, your mentality is like that of a scoundrel on the street. Strength? Temperament? "
Luo Zheng's words abruptly changed the topic, and the two Demon Race cultivators were left speechless!
The War Senior called Mo Xie's face was gloomy. He suddenly took two steps forward and a majestic aura pressed down on Luo Zheng.
Master Jing also quietly got up and was about to block in front of Luo Zheng, but Luo Zheng gently waved his hand, indicating for Master Jing not to move. Luo Zheng instead took two steps towards Mo Xie. The distance between the two was very close!
Ordinary warriors would probably tremble in front of a War Senior, especially under the pressure of that soul pressure, they might even be injured.
Although fighting was prohibited in the safe zone, the Demon Race's tyranny was well known in the Tower of Sin. Even if there was a dispute, it would eventually reach the upper levels. Their Demon Race occupied twenty-two seats out of the hundred seats, so in the end, it would be left unsettled!
However, Mo Xie didn't intend to make a big deal out of this matter. He just wanted to let this kid suffer a little loss!
However, Luo Zheng had a faint smile on his face from beginning to end. He stared at Mo Xie with a face like a spring breeze, then sighed and said, "I already said, you're just a First Order War Senior. Do you really think you're something? Your aura is even worse than Yue Shou's. Apart from your cultivation base, you're nothing … "
Master Jing looked at Luo Zheng's calm expression and was pleasantly surprised. However, he didn't know that not to mention a War Senior, even the War Saints of the Purple Heart Holy Land couldn't suppress Luo Zheng with just their aura! The War Saints of the Sea God Continent were on the same level as the Life and Death experts of the Central Domain. When Luo Zheng faced Cui Xie's aura, he didn't even move, let alone these War Seniors.
"Arrogant!" Seeing that his soul pressure wasn't able to suppress Luo Zheng, the Demon Scorpion was helpless. Just like the rumors said, this human boy was a complete freak!
"Arrogant? Hahahaha! " This time, it was Luo Zheng's turn to laugh, "Then, I'll let you see if I'm really arrogant. I'll let you see what a real aura is!"
After he finished speaking, Luo Zheng's eyes flashed. His Combat Soul Realm soul suddenly moved, and a majestic soul pressure spread out from Luo Zheng's body in an earth-shattering manner!

Chapter 566
One's aura was determined by the strength of one's soul. The stronger one's soul was, the more astonishing their aura would be.
However, after Luo Zheng's soul entered the War Soul realm, he restrained his aura. The average person simply couldn't sense it. Only a true powerhouse could see just how powerful Luo Zheng's soul was.
The soul of a War Soul realm was something that even a War Saint powerhouse would find difficult to obtain. One would need to break through to the Divine Sea realm to be able to condense it!
Such a boundless aura gushed out from Luo Zheng's body, rushing out in all directions like a tide. And, this War Saint called Mo Scorpion was the first to bear the brunt of this aura!
Mo Scorpion's fist-sized eyes suddenly widened. In front of him, this human warrior was like a peerless vicious beast!
Luo Zheng didn't use a soul attack. After all, he was a newcomer and there were too few seats for humans in the Sin Tower. Once he attacked, the situation would be far from good. If the 14 races joined forces to punish him, Luo Zheng wouldn't have the ability to resist!
After all, the Sin Tower didn't only have these War Saints, but also many War Saint powerhouses!
As Luo Zheng's aura erupted, he also communicated with the Slaughter Sword Mountain, causing the infernal energy stored within to erupt. With the pressure of his soul combined with the surging infernal energy, Luo Zheng was like a Death God that had come to life!
"Pa!"
In the wine shop, a young servant was carrying a jug of wine. As he felt the aura that was leaking out, his legs went soft and the jug of wine fell to the ground, shattering into pieces. The young servant's face was deathly pale. He held onto the table beside him as if he couldn't stand steadily!
The young servant only bore a little of Luo Zheng's aura. Almost all of Luo Zheng's aura dissipated in front of him. The first ones to bear the brunt of this were Mo Scorpion and another War Saint.
At this moment, the Devil Scorpion felt that he couldn't breathe. His mind was blank. How could this human kid have such a terrifying aura … As Luo Zheng's aura increased little by little, the Evil Qi was released little by little. The Devil Scorpion couldn't help but take two steps back. His whole body was trembling, and his teeth were chattering.
The situation of the other War Reverend wasn't any better. The two of them had just broken through to War Reverends. After crossing a realm, the two War Reverends felt that they had touched upon a brand new domain. They could be considered to have truly entered the upper echelons of the Tower of Sins!
In the Tower of Sin, warriors were the lowest level, warriors were the middle level, and War Venerables were the upper level!
After they became war elders, they heard rumors from the demon clan that a particularly powerful little ant had appeared among the humans. Thus, the two of them wanted to come down and destroy the might of this little ant of a warrior of the eighth step! Who would have thought that this little ant was actually so terrifying?
Annoyance and regret filled their hearts. If this matter was spread out, not only would they lose face for the Demon Race, a dignified Demon Race War Elder would actually be suppressed by a human warrior!
But how could they resist now?
Unless they directly attacked!
But if they attacked here, not only would there be a human War Reverend beside them, the two of them might not be able to get away with it!
As time passed, the two War Reverends were unable to withstand Luo Zheng's pressure and could only continuously retreat. They only stopped when they reached the entrance of the tavern.
The two War Reverends' expressions were extremely gloomy. They clenched their huge fists and stared at Luo Zheng, but couldn't say a word.
Luo Zheng stored his baleful aura into the Slaughter Sword Mountain and quickly retracted his soul pressure. He immediately returned to his previous appearance with a faint smile on his face, giving people a feeling like a spring breeze. Who would have thought that this young man's pressure would force the two War Reverends to retreat?
Seeing that the two War Reverends hadn't left, Luo Zheng said indifferently, "Still want to disgrace yourself?"
Mo Scorpion clenched his teeth and glared at Luo Zheng. In the end, he didn't return to the tavern. He only glared at Luo Zheng and said angrily, "I will wait for you below!"
After that, Mo Scorpion and the other War Reverend flicked their sleeves and left!
Just now, when Luo Zheng's aura spread out, it attracted many creatures in the surroundings, including Warriors and Generals of different races …
They, who were standing at the entrance, saw a human Warrior forcing the two War Reverends out of the tavern by relying on his soul pressure. They were so shocked that their jaws dropped.
"Is, is that kid really a human Warrior?"
"He is indeed an eighth step Warrior called Luo Zheng. He just entered the Tower of Sin a few days ago … If he can't take down Luo Zheng in the arena, this kid will climb to the top of the Tower of Sin. I'm afraid the human race will have one more seat!"
"When did the human race give birth to such a genius? Even the Demon Race and Yao Ye Clan can't find a second one with such strength!"
"Hehe, are you kidding? Since ancient times, such a thing has never happened in our Sea God Continent. The pressure of a Warrior forcing a War Reverend to retreat is simply unimaginable. If it weren't for the bad relationship between the human race and the demon race, I would have thought they were acting! "
Many creatures were discussing at the entrance.
Xia Shuang, who had been sitting in her original position, stared blankly at the youth in front of her. Her beautiful eyes were somewhat infatuated.
Xia Shuang, who came from the Purple Heart Holy Lands, used to be so arrogant. Even in the Holy Lands, which young genius could catch her eye?
Humans were weak on the Sea God Continent, and the geniuses of the Holy Lands rarely went out to train. Xia Shuang was no exception! When she first walked out of the Holy Lands, Xia Shuang felt that she was the pride of the heavens and that the geniuses of the world were nothing more than this.
But when she entered the Tower of Sin with the same group of geniuses, she discovered just how weak the human race was compared to the other races!
Whether it was the Yao Ye Clan, the Demon Race, or the Giant Race, they were all much stronger than the human race. So when she climbed up the Tower of Sin, she trembled all the way.
Sometimes, Xia Shuang wondered if the human race was really inferior to the other races! Just like the Yao Ye Clan, they were born strong and had no impurities in their bodies. From the moment they were born, they were Xiantian lifeforms!
That was until … she saw Luo Zheng.
When she first received the news, she and the others from Starshine tried to contact Luo Zheng. But this human warrior that had crawled out from some unknown crack had actually encountered an 'empty field' as soon as he entered the Tower of Sin. Hearing this, Xia Shuang felt that this human youth was quite good.
The geniuses of the Purple Heart Holy Lands generally didn't dare to enter the Tower of Sin. Everyone knew that geniuses needed to undergo sufficient tempering in order to grow. But, the Purple Heart Holy Lands didn't dare to send anyone into the Tower of Sin. There was no other reason than that they would die too quickly. No matter how many geniuses were sent in, they would all die. How could the Purple Heart Holy Lands dare to send their geniuses in while they were still fighting?
And for Luo Zheng to encounter an 'empty field' as a warrior was already an amazing feat for the human race.
But that idiot Starshine had offended Luo Zheng as soon as he arrived.
And Luo Zheng was indeed arrogant, as if he didn't put the Purple Heart Holy Lands in his eyes.
However, the message passed down from the Holy Land was that they had to maintain a good relationship with Luo Zheng. If this youth could really grow up, then he might be able to obtain another seat for the human race. With another seat, there would be more hope. Within the Sea God Continent, no matter which race it was, they all valued a seat in the Sin Tower!
But when she came into contact with Luo Zheng again, Luo Zheng had actually defeated the god-level genius of the Yao Ye Clan, Purple Jade!
This result … caused Xia Shuang's heart to tremble.
She felt that there was finally a man in this world who could enter her sights!
So when Luo Zheng asked her how much it would cost for a night, Xia Shuang was furious, but in the end, she forced herself to endure.
For a true powerhouse, arrogance wasn't a sign of stupidity. It was just a sign of their inherent pride.
At this time, Xia Shuang had already raised Luo Zheng's strength infinitely. With the cultivation of a rank eight warrior, Luo Zheng might be able to fight against a rank nine or even a rank ten warrior!
Xia Shuang felt that she had overestimated Luo Zheng to have such strength with such cultivation. But what Xia Shuang never expected was that Luo Zheng would be able to force two Demon Race War Reverends back with just his aura.
This was simply unimaginable!
This youth suddenly became incomparably mysterious in Xia Shuang's eyes!

Chapter 567
The smile on Lord Jing's face became even brighter.
Perhaps he thought that the destiny of the Purple Heart Holy Lands these past few years had improved with the appearance of Luo Zheng.
On the Sea God Continent where hundreds of races fought for supremacy, the human race had a chance to turn the tables.
The human race's specialty lay in cultivating true essence. In this aspect, they had an incomparable advantage over other races. 300 years ago and 100 years ago, the human race had produced two God-rank talents.
These two God-rank talents had an extremely high chance of reaching the Divine Sea realm!
Unfortunately, the first God-rank talent had just left the Purple Heart Holy Lands when he was killed by another race. As for the other God-rank talent, although he had grown up, he had ultimately perished in the Profound Nether Cave. Although the Profound Nether Cave contained great lucky chances, it was also extremely dangerous. Even a War Saint would fall if they weren't careful. They wouldn't even have a chance to resist.
However, Lord Jing could see that this Luo Zheng of unknown origins was strong, far surpassing the strength of an ordinary Warrior. His pure strength was terrifying enough to fight against a tenth step War General, and the strength of his soul seemed to be able to suppress a war elder!
If this youth reached the Divine Sea realm, perhaps no one in the entire Sea God Continent would be able to stop his growth.
Judging from this point, Lord Jing felt that the Purple Heart Holy Lands could leave Luo Zheng with as many resources as they wanted.
Lord Jing's goal of meeting with Luo Zheng had been achieved. In truth, Lord Jing wanted to take a step further. He wanted to invite Luo Zheng to the Purple Heart Holy Lands. In the cursed lands, there was a transmission array that led to the Purple Heart Holy Lands. If the Divine Sea Supreme Elders of the Holy Lands were willing to guide Luo Zheng, or even use the Purple Heart Disk to help Luo Zheng, that would be the best outcome.
However, Lord Jing also understood that he was overthinking things. Even the God-rank talents of the Holy Lands didn't receive such treatment. This wasn't something he could decide, so he didn't say anything.
Just as Lord Jing left with Xia Shuang, Xia Shuang suddenly turned her head and said, "You still don't know my name!"
"What's your name?" Luo Zheng faintly smiled.
"Xia as in summer, Shuang as in autumn!" Saying this, Xia Shuang smiled gracefully and turned to leave with Lord Jing.
Back in the living area, Luo Zheng rented a new secret cultivation room and continued to refine the Light of Creation he had obtained from Purple Jade. Relying on the Light of Creation, Luo Zheng's cultivation improved very quickly!
Luo Zheng's goal was to become a War Elder in the Sin Tower!
Only by reaching the level of a war elder would Luo Zheng be able to fight against Cui Xie and defeat Cui Xie.
After entering the Sin Tower, Luo Zheng had only experienced a few battles. When he fought with the warriors on the first floor, the Light of Creation obtained by Luo Zheng allowed Luo Zheng to advance from a Rank 7 warrior to a Rank 8 warrior. However, this was also because Luo Zheng was originally on the verge of a breakthrough, and the Light of Creation was only a catalyst.
On the second floor, Luo Zheng obtained a lot of Light of Creation from Purple Jade. However, after absorbing all the Light of Creation, Luo Zheng didn't break through. According to Luo Zheng's judgment, he would need to absorb an equal amount of Light of Creation before he could break through.
Purple Jade's Light of Creation came from other warriors, while the other warriors' Light of Creation were obtained from the warriors on the first and second floors. Naturally, there wouldn't be a lot of it.
"It seems that I have to climb to the higher floors of the Sin Tower as soon as possible. The amount of Light of Creation on the lower floors is too little." Luo Zheng's goal was the warriors in the Sin Tower.
Those warriors had also climbed up step by step. After reaching the fifth floor, the amount of Light of Creation in their hands would naturally be much more than what they had now!
Unfortunately, the rules of the Sin Tower had restrictions. He had to climb up one floor at a time. Even if all the floors were empty, it would still take a long time.
After resting for an entire night, Luo Zheng walked out of the cultivation room the next day. When he entered the arena, the entire place was silent. There were warriors fighting day and night in the arena.
The matter of Luo Zheng using his aura to force away the two demon war elders had already spread throughout the second floor. Or rather, the majority of the people in the Sin Tower knew that a terrifying fiend had appeared on the second floor. Although that guy was from the human race, his battle strength far exceeded those of the same realm. For the time being, his strength had yet to reach its limit!
Yesterday, Luo Zheng had already defeated the Demon Night Clan's god-ranked genius, Purple Jade. Now, who would dare to challenge Luo Zheng?
When Luo Zheng first arrived, there were two different races fighting in the arena. When the victor was decided, the winner noticed Luo Zheng outside the arena and his expression changed greatly. As if he had been bitten by a snake, he quickly jumped out of the arena.
According to the rules of the Sin Tower, one could fight at will in the arena. If Luo Zheng came up and instantly killed him, he would have died in vain …
Seeing that creature escape, the warriors didn't laugh at him.
No one's life was picked up from the ground. If he was killed by Luo Zheng, he would have died in vain. He would only become a stepping stone for Luo Zheng to climb up. In such a situation, anyone would run away from the arena.
However, the irony was that that creature had already won 16 consecutive victories. He was an overlord on the second floor!
Unfortunately, this overlord had been very depressed these days. First, he encountered Purple Jade. That creature didn't dare to accept the challenge and directly chose to go into seclusion. Now, Luo Zheng had jumped out …
Luo Zheng pretended not to see their actions. That was how the upper echelons were. Of course, Luo Zheng didn't care about the thoughts of these warriors. Those who blocked his path would only have the fate of being crushed.
After entering the arena, Luo Zheng asked indifferently, "Does anyone dare to challenge me?"
Emptying the arena should be the best outcome. Everyone would be happy. As long as the arena was emptied today and tomorrow, the fighters of the second floor would be able to send off Luo Zheng with great joy. At this moment, who would dare to come up and seek death?
All the creatures were silent. They all wanted this guy to get out of here as soon as possible. Every day Luo Zheng stayed here was a kind of torture for them.
However, at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded. "I'll challenge you!"
Hearing this voice, everyone's expression suddenly changed. Luo Zheng's brows also furrowed.
"Who dares to challenge Luo Zheng? Damn it, whether you live or die is none of our business. But if you challenge him, Luo Zheng will have to wait for three days before he can go up to the third floor! Isn't this harming him? "
"That's right! Let Luo Zheng advance freely. If you want to challenge him, go to the third floor and do it! "
"It seems that Luo Zheng will have to stay on the second floor for a few more days …"
While many creatures were cursing, the person who spoke walked out leisurely. It was Purple Jade of the Demon Night Clan!
Purple Jade looked coldly at the warriors who were cursing and said angrily, "What … What did you say?!"
Many warriors immediately shut up.
They had forgotten that there was still a fiend here!
Luo Zheng was indeed terrifying, but this Purple Jade wasn't bad either. In any case, to these fighters, both of them were existences that could not be defeated. This woman was originally in a bad mood after Luo Zheng's "empty stage" yesterday. If they really offended her, it would be troublesome for her to stay on the second floor!
The weak had a lot of trouble …
The warriors on the first floor to the fifth floor had such a tragic fate. If they couldn't climb up, they could only be a stepping stone for others forever. This was the only time the rules of the Sin Tower had changed.
In the early days, there was no free promotion in the Sin Tower, so there was a group of warlords from the major races grinding points on the lower floors. If they didn't have enough points, they couldn't advance at all. At that time, the lives of warriors were completely reduced to a tool for warlords to grind points, and warlords were reduced to tools for warlords to grind points.
Moreover, the Sin Tower at that time was even more chaotic than it was now. There wasn't even a so-called safe area. If they encountered some race's geniuses, they would kill them at will. It was incomparably cruel.
Seeing Purple Jade of the Demon Night Clan come out again, Luo Zheng was unhappy. Could it be that she deliberately came to make trouble because he ended her "empty stage" yesterday? Could it be that this woman really thinks I don't dare to kill her? Thinking of this, Luo Zheng's eyes emitted a fierce light as he stared at Purple Jade.
For some reason, after being stared at by Luo Zheng, Purple Jade felt a little flustered. However, she didn't directly go to the arena. Instead, she added, "I want to challenge you, but not on the second floor! For the time being, I'll let you go to the third floor. If I catch up to you, I'll challenge you! "
Hearing Purple Jade's words, many creatures breathed a sigh of relief and sighed inwardly. Fortunately, this Demon Night Clan woman wasn't stupid. Luo Zheng let her go yesterday, yet she still wants to challenge Luo Zheng today and end Luo Zheng's empty stage. Isn't she courting death?

Chapter 568
Hearing Zi Yu's words, a smile appeared on Luo Zheng's face. It seemed that Zi Yu was really unconvinced.
If he met her on the third or fourth floor, Luo Zheng would give her the opportunity to challenge him.
Standing in the arena, Luo Zheng waited for a long time, but no one came up to challenge him. Luo Zheng's "empty arena" for today could be considered completed.
A day later, Luo Zheng once again stepped onto the arena. After completing the third empty arena, Luo Zheng smoothly obtained the qualifications to advance to the third floor. Immediately after, Luo Zheng moved on to the next floor.
From the first to the fifth floor of the Tower of Sin, warriors were active, but the proportion of warriors was gradually increasing. From the fifth floor onwards, warriors were basically nowhere to be seen. It was completely the world of warriors.
Because of Luo Zheng's arrival, the first to the fifth floor caused a sensation. The warriors on the third floor were not fools. When they saw Luo Zheng, almost all of them obediently made way for him. Only a few reckless creatures wanted to challenge Luo Zheng.
As Luo Zheng climbed up the floors, the attention of many creatures on Luo Zheng also increased. This was even more so for human warriors. Many warriors on the upper floors ran down to watch Luo Zheng's fights. Unfortunately, there were very few warriors who dared to challenge Luo Zheng. Even if they dared to stand on the arena, they would often be instantly defeated by Luo Zheng. There was simply no exciting scene to watch, and no one could see how strong Luo Zheng was.
On the west side of the tenth floor of the Tower of Sin, there was a huge room. This area had always been occupied by the Demon Race, and other races were not allowed to approach it.
In the Tower of Sin, all the areas were public, but in fact, the Demon Race controlled the most areas, and also the largest area.
In the past, the Demon Race wanted to monopolize the entire Tower of Sin.
In fact, the Demon Race almost succeeded. At that time, there was a famous "Blocking the Door" incident.
At that time, the Demon Race occupied 60 seats in the Tower of Sin! As the most powerful force in the Tower of Sin, the Demon Race suddenly issued an order to expel all the creatures of other races from the Tower of Sin. Those who refused to leave the Tower would be beheaded.
At that time, the Devil Race did it. None of the races were left in the pagoda. They were all driven out!
During that one month, only demons could use the Tower of Sin.
However, this action of the Demon Race had infuriated everyone!
Even though the Demon Clan was the most prosperous clan on the Sea God's Continent and the only clan to own two Sacred Lands, the other clans were still a force to be reckoned with when they joined forces! Disregarding everything else, just the Demon Night Clan's Sacred Land alone was difficult for the Demon Race to resist. Only if the Flame Demon Sacred Land and the Phobic Demon Sacred Land joined forces would they have a chance of stopping the Demon Night Clan.
At that time, all the races joined forces and almost attacked the two Holy Lands of the Demon Race.
After all, the Sacred Lands of the Sea God's Continent relied heavily on the Sin Tower. If they lost the Sin Tower, which was a machine that bred powerhouses, it would be a devastating blow to the Sacred Lands of many races.
If they lost the younger generation, it would be tantamount to losing the foundation of their foothold. In the future, when the Demon Race gradually grew stronger, they would sooner or later wipe out the other races on the continent. Rather than waiting until that time came, it was better to fight to the death with the Demon Race's Holy Land now!
Seeing that the allied forces of many races were about to arrive at the Demon Race's Holy Land, the Demon Race finally understood that they had touched something they shouldn't have.
With no other choice, the Demon Race reopened the doors of the Sin Tower and unwillingly gave up a portion of their seats.
Therefore, the distribution of power in the Sin Tower was actually a microcosm of the Sea God's Continent. The Human Race was easy to bully, so the Human Race didn't have a high status in the Sin Tower. The Demon Night Clan was hard to deal with, so the Demon Night Clan couldn't be underestimated in the Sin Tower.
Even though the Demon Race gave up the Sin Tower, the majority of the tower was still controlled by the Demon Race.
This huge room was decorated very crudely. Several Demon Race people were either sitting or lying down, discussing something.
Not long after, a cloaked Demon Race war reverend walked in from the door and said, "The order from the top has been passed down. They want to send men of sacrifice to assassinate Luo Zheng."
"What! Assassinate that brat? "Moon Guardian, who was sitting in the corner, suddenly stood up.
Several Demon Race war reverends indifferently glanced at Moon Guardian. A Demon Race war reverend walked out from beside the cloaked Demon Race war reverend and coldly said, "Moon Guardian, you don't have the right to speak here!"
Moon Guardian was not afraid, "When that brat enters the tenth floor, I will naturally take his life. Why would I need to assassinate him?"
The cloaked Demon Race war reverend indifferently stared at Moon Guardian. This was because Moon Guardian was the most talented god-rank genius in the Flame Demon Holy Land. If it was any other Demon Race war reverend, who would dare to interrupt the Demon Race war reverend's conversation?
"I understand your feelings, but this is an order from the top of the tower," the Demon Race war reverend indifferently said, "This brat is only a warrior, yet he can give a war reverend so much pressure. If he is promoted to a general, his strength will most likely be unstoppable. Are you sure you are his match?"
"I can defeat him!" Moon Guardian clenched his teeth and said.
The Demon Race war reverend sneered, "I believe you, but it's useless. Luo Zheng's life will be taken away by the Night Clan's men of sacrifice!"
The Night Clan was the sixth-ranked race on the Sea God Continent. This race lived in the night and lived in the darkness.
This race was not considered strong in direct combat, but they were naturally skilled in assassination. They could silently take the life of their opponent without them noticing!
Because they were not skilled in direct combat, without the protection of other races, the Night Clan could not grow in strength on the Sea God Continent. The reason this race was able to become the sixth-ranked race on the Sea God Continent was because of the Demon Race's protection!
To a certain extent, the entire Night Clan was controlled by the Demon Race!
Therefore, the Night Clan specially cultivated men of sacrifice and sent them into the Tower of Sin to assassinate targets that needed to be eliminated.
In fact, all the major races were well aware of the inside story. However, as long as the Demon Race did not go overboard and did not offend the geniuses of the major races, it was fine as long as they maintained the balance in the Tower of Sin.
In the past, the Demon Race would not send men of sacrifice to human martial artists.
The cost of cultivating a man of sacrifice was very high. The human race could not afford this treatment.
However, this time was different. Luo Zheng was too dazzling. From the moment he entered the Tower of Sin, he was destined to alarm the powerhouses at the top of the Tower of Sin!
In the past, there were examples of geniuses of other races rapidly climbing up the Tower of Sin. However, those geniuses were all Battle Generals! This time, Luo Zheng began to climb up as a Battle Warrior. In addition, the Tower of Sin was a holy land for cultivation. Everyone was well aware of the speed at which one could increase their cultivation through the Light of Good Fortune.
Once Luo Zheng climbed to the top of the Tower, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Yue Shou revealed a disappointed expression. He was looking forward to his battle with Luo Zheng. However, Zhan Zun's words made Yue Shou understand that he might not have this opportunity. Yue Shou was well aware of the strength of the Night Clan's assassins.

Yue Shou clenched his fists. In his heart, he faintly hoped that this assassination would not succeed …
Luo Zheng was unaware of the danger that was approaching him step by step. He passed through the third floor very smoothly. For three days, no one dared to challenge him. After three consecutive no-shows, he obtained the qualification to ascend to the fourth floor freely.
Unfortunately, because no one challenged him, he could not obtain the Light of Good Fortune …
This was indeed a problem. The Light of Good Fortune was very important to Luo Zheng. However, on second thought, he decided to just go to the upper floor and snatch the Light of Good Fortune from the Battle Generals.

At this rate, she was afraid that she would not be able to catch up with Luo Zheng. On the first day Luo Zheng entered the fourth floor, there were no surprises. After obtaining the Light of Good Fortune, Luo Zheng continued to rent a secret cultivation room to cultivate.
What made Luo Zheng depressed was that because there were no Light of Good Fortune, not only did Luo Zheng not obtain any points, but he also did not obtain any Light of Good Fortune. Therefore, he had to rely on True Essence Stones to rent the secret cultivation room …

Chapter 569
Luo Zheng's face revealed a trace of doubt.
The architecture of the Sin Tower was very special. It was said that as long as something was placed anywhere, it would disappear after a long time and be swallowed by the Sin Tower.

This huge tower was like a monster. Apart from living things, everything that was not alive would be devoured by it.

That special aura had always existed in this secret room!

No matter, no matter who you are, you'll still make a move against me! Luo Zheng's eyes narrowed slightly. All the muscles in his body were tense, but he seemed to be very relaxed as he sat down.

The Night Clan was famous for their assassins because they were born to be stealthy and good at hiding their presence.

For an assassin of the Night Clan, the most dangerous mission was to assassinate someone in the Tower of Sin.
Because of the rules of the Tower of Sin, even if he succeeded in his assassination, he would be hunted down by the other races. Assassinating the target and then retreating from the Tower of Sin was simply too difficult.

This brat seemed to be very confident in his own strength.

The Night Clan assassin began to quietly move along the wall of the secret room. A white bone blade appeared in his hand.

At this distance, he had never failed.
In his eyes, Luo Zheng was already a dead man.

His bone blade suddenly erupted at this moment. A true assassin was like this!
At the moment of the assassination, everything should be abandoned. At this moment, the Night Clan assassin only had one target in his eyes, and that was Luo Zheng's heart.
This stab should be able to pierce through this brat's heart.

The brat in front of him didn't counterattack, nor did he dodge his bone blade. However, the bone blade was nailed to his back and couldn't advance any further.
How was this possible? Was this brat's body made of steel?

After Luo Zheng's body became a high-grade immortal tool, its strength had increased to an unprecedented level. Ordinary weapons simply couldn't break through the defense of his body.
An assassin who dared to make a move in the Tower of Sin must be a death warrior who was willing to risk his life.
How could a War Venerable expert be willing to become a death warrior? Therefore, Luo Zheng concluded that this assassin's strength couldn't surpass a War Venerable. Even if his concealment method was powerful, it was useless if he couldn't break through Luo Zheng's physical defense. Therefore, Luo Zheng calmly waited for the assassin to make the first move.
"Bang!"

Under Luo Zheng's fist, the night clan assassin directly rolled out and crawled on the wall. He spat out a mouthful of blood on the bone blade in his hand. The bone blade began to emit a bewitching red color. The night clan assassin's eyes were red, as if he was a scorpion hiding on the wall!
Although he was a death warrior, he wouldn't sit still and wait for death in a life and death situation. Since he couldn't kill Luo Zheng with one strike, he was already in an extremely disadvantageous situation. If he wanted to turn the tables now, he could only gamble with his life!
"Did the demon race send you?" Luo Zheng asked indifferently.
"Do you think I'll tell you?" The night clan assassin said coldly.
"Hehe, I'm not interested in knowing!" Luo Zheng's voice fell. His figure suddenly flashed, and two loud bangs were heard!
The night clan assassin quickly dodged on the wall. The wall where he had just stopped had two fist imprints, but those fist imprints were quickly disappearing … …
This was the magic of the Tower of Sin. Even if it suffered great damage, it would quickly repair itself. It was as if it wasn't a tower, but a person.
It was also because this was the Tower of Sin. If it was any other place, Luo Zheng's two punches would have caused the entire building to collapse.

Chapter 570
In fact, the easiest way for Luo Zheng to escape was to open the door of the secret room and walk out.

The Tower of Sin was a microcosm of the entire Sea God Continent. The higher one's cultivation was, the higher one's position would be. Every floor of the Tower of Sin operated according to a pattern. Those who were powerful would obtain the Light of Creation and their cultivation would rapidly increase. Those who were weak would either hide in a certain floor and remain stagnant or become a stepping stone for other experts.
From the sixth floor onward, the number of warlords who dared to challenge Luo Zheng increased.

Luo Zheng was only a single step away from becoming a warlord!
Luo Zheng was looking forward to stepping into the warlord realm. If his cultivation could reach the warlord realm, he might be able to rely on his mortal body to contend with those early warlord powerhouses! It had to be known that he cultivated the transcendent divine might 'Stellar War Body' and had yet to display it in front of others!

Chapter 571
Breaking through from a Warrior to a Warrior was the same as breaking through from the Divine Reflection realm to the Divine Core realm.
In order to break through this realm, one would need to accumulate a considerable amount of Light of Fortune.
Although the warriors in the Tower of Sin could break through at a very fast speed, even those Saint rank geniuses would need to spend a long time in the Tower of Sin before they could break through.
Although Luo Zheng had fewer chances to break through, and his speed of breaking through had slowed down, the amount of Light of Fortune he had accumulated had increased. However, Luo Zheng didn't absorb these Light of Fortune. Instead, he gathered them together and used them to break through to the Warrior realm.
In the Tower of Sin, the warriors on the seventh floor were between Rank 3 Warlords and Rank 6 Warlords, the warriors on the eighth floor were between Rank 5 Warlords and Rank 8 Warlords, and the warriors on the ninth floor were between Rank 7 Warlords and Rank 10 Warlords.

One month later, Luo Zheng finally entered the tenth floor of the Tower of Sin.
From this floor onwards, Luo Zheng would only encounter two types of opponents. One would be Divine Realm Warriors, and the other would be Reverends!

What was even more ridiculous was that until now, Luo Zheng hadn't been able to reveal his true strength!
No matter if it was facing a rank one battle general of the sixth floor or a rank ten battle general of the ninth floor, Luo Zheng was always calm and composed. It was as though these battle generals could not force him to use his true trump card.
Luo Zheng's deeds were now like a storm that swept across the entire Sea God Continent.
Even if Luo Zheng had not done anything, he had already made a great contribution to the Purple Heart Holy Land. In the Purple Heart Holy Land, there were people talking about the human boy who suddenly appeared in the Tower of Sin almost every day!

The jealousy in his heart towards Luo Zheng naturally increased with each passing day.

Luo Zheng was indeed uncertain.

Chapter 572
From the Central Domain, which was the Tianbei Region, to the Sea God Continent, the distance between the two continents was hundreds of thousands of kilometers. Luo Zheng couldn't think of any other way to get here except for the large transmission array in the Heaven Mist Immortal Tomb.

Yun Luo's clothes, appearance, and temperament were almost exactly the same. There was no difference at all. Only her cultivation and cultivation method were different.
In White Emperor City, Yun Luo majored in boundary techniques, while here, Yun Luo majored in finger techniques.
Just as Luo Zheng was thinking carefully, the beastman in the arena suddenly roared. The giant axe in his hand swept up a gust of wind as he wildly swung it at Yun Luo.
Yun Luo's seemingly soft body was like a leaf in a gust of wind. She constantly shuttled back and forth between the giant axe. Every time she dodged, she was only a few centimeters away from the giant axe.

"Yes, the warriors of our human race challenge Yun Luo. Yun Luo can just admit defeat and the Light of Creation she has accumulated will belong to her opponent," Xia Shuang said with a wink.

The warriors who entered the Tower of Sin did so for the Light of Creation in order to quickly improve their cultivation. However, not only did Yun Luo need the Light of Creation, but she also wanted to transfer the Light of Creation to others?
