"I'll make a trip to the Purple Heart Holy Land, but before that, I'm afraid I'll have to go to the Demon Night Clan's Heavenly Feather Holy Land first. Let's talk about it when I come back." Luo Zheng smiled and made a promise.
Hearing Luo Zheng's words, a trace of gratitude appeared in the hearts of the two Peak War Elder s. To think that a War Elder would be so grateful to a Warrior, this was something that was unprecedented …
The two of them clearly understood the meaning behind Luo Zheng's words. Since Luo Zheng had already reached this step, he should be leading the Human Race to rise. Although only two Demon Battle Saints had died today, they believed that in the near future, the entire Sin Tower would be reshuffled!
Then Luo Zheng turned around and left. He wanted to rent a cultivation room to slowly cultivate.
Seeing Luo Zheng's back slowly leave, Xia Shuang wanted to say something, but when the words reached her mouth, she was suddenly speechless. In the end, she did not say anything.
In the cultivation room, Luo Zheng sat quietly. Suddenly, a helpless smile appeared on his face.
He suddenly realized that his body was very crowded. Not only were there nine True Dragons in his mind, there was also a mysterious furnace of unknown origin. The Sword Spirit in his body was actually the "King" of the Demon Night Clan, and it also had its own consciousness …
This was really lively!
After shaking his head, Luo Zheng took out the Light of Creation from his nameplate and began to slowly refine it.
Yue Shou and Mu Qing Yang were the strongest among the tenth level Battle Generals. In the previous battles, the two of them had not tasted defeat. The amount of Light of Creation in their nameplates was not an ordinary amount!
When Luo Zheng took out the Light of Creation, the blazing white light was unimaginably dense!
"With so much Light of Creation, I should be able to break through!"
Thinking of this, Luo Zheng's True Yuan suddenly circulated. Traces of True Yuan continuously refined the Light of Creation and poured it into Luo Zheng's body …
Three days later, Luo Zheng left the cultivation room. When Luo Zheng came out again, Mu Qing Yang, who was standing at the entrance of the cultivation room, gave him a bright smile.
The Demon Night Clan was waiting for Luo Zheng to come out.
Of course, the Demon Night Clan was not interested in Luo Zheng himself, but the sword spirit within Luo Zheng's body, Xun.
Luo Zheng nodded and said to Mu Qing Yang, "Let's go."
Although Luo Zheng's time was tight, since he promised to take Xun to the Heavenly Feather Sacred Land, he would naturally do it.
Moreover, there was still some time before the Mysterious Underworld Cave opened. Even if Luo Zheng wanted to return to the Central Domain, he would have to enter the Mysterious Underworld Cave and obtain the inheritance within. Therefore, Luo Zheng still had plenty of time.
Under Mu Qing Yang's lead, Luo Zheng returned to the first floor of the Sin Tower. After waiting at the entrance for a while, Ling Yan, who was ranked first among the seat controllers, came over with two peak War Reverends.
After the few of them met up, they left the Sin Tower and headed south of the Cursed Lands.
Flying was forbidden in the Cursed Lands. If one tried to fly by force, there would be a terrifying force pressing down on them. When Luo Zheng had just entered the Sin Tower, he had also suffered from this. Therefore, they could only choose to walk.
However, with the strength of their legs, they managed to cover quite a distance after a few hours. Soon, a large teleportation array appeared in front of them.
Mu Qingyang was the first to step forward. He took out True Origin Stones from his pocket and placed them on the Teleportation Array. After the True Origin Stones were placed, the entire Teleportation Array suddenly burst into light.
"Let's go in." Ling Yan nodded to Luo Zheng.
Luo Zheng immediately stepped into the teleportation formation. He naturally knew that this was the teleportation formation that led to the Demon Night Clan's Heavenly Feather Sacred Land.
Then, a blue light enveloped Luo Zheng and the few of them continuously traveled through the teleportation formation. After an incense stick's worth of time, they reached the end of the teleportation formation. When the light dissipated, Luo Zheng smelled a faint fragrance of flowers.
The scenery here was very different from the Cursed Lands.
In the Cursed Lands, other than the various races, there was no life. Here, there were emerald green jungles everywhere. All kinds of plants grew luxuriantly, and colorful flowers bloomed regardless of season. It was as beautiful as a paradise on earth.
When Luo Zheng raised his head, he saw a huge tree in the distance.
"That tree is …" Luo Zheng asked.
"It's our Demon Night Clan's Sacred Tree. Every Demon Night Clan's Sacred Land will nurture a Sacred Tree," Mu Qing Yang explained with a smile.
The Demon Night Clan's reproduction method was completely different from what Luo Zheng had imagined. After the Demon Night Clan's members were born, they would be placed in the Sacred Tree and rely on the Sacred Tree to absorb the essence of heaven and earth. The Demon Night Clan's members who slowly grew in the Sacred Tree had stronger physiques than other clans. Moreover, from the moment they were born, there were no impurities in their bodies. They were natural born Xiantian lifeforms.
This was the reason why the Demon Night Clan's members were much stronger than other clans.
However, in the Great Thousand World, there was a delicate balance. The Demon Night Clan's members were strong, but their reproduction ability was very weak. Even though the Heavenly Feather Sacred Land was called a Rank Seven Sacred Land, there were only about a million Demon Night Clan members in the entire Sacred Land.
As for the human Purple Heart Sacred Land, it had just entered the Rank Six Sacred Land, but its population was a hundred times more than the Demon Night Clan's!
At that moment, the red light beside Luo Zheng flashed. Specks of light slowly condensed and Xun's figure slowly took shape.
When Xun appeared, Mu Qing Yang, Ling Yan, and the others seemed to reflexively kneel in front of her.
Seeing this scene, Luo Zheng was speechless. Did they have to keep kneeling like this?
Xun didn't pay attention to them at all. She just looked at the Sacred Tree in the distance and said indifferently, "Get up." Then she said to Luo Zheng, "Let's go!"
Then Luo Zheng jumped up and sped through the air with Xun.
As for Ling Yan, Mu Qing Yang, and the others, they also flew up and followed behind.
During the flight, Luo Zheng suddenly approached Xun and asked, "You … How do you know Yun Luo?"
Xun glanced at Luo Zheng indifferently and answered, "Because I know her."
Luo Zheng rolled his eyes and could only ask again, "I've seen another Yun Luo in the Central Domain. They look exactly the same. What's going on? Are they the same person? "
"Yes." Xun nodded. "Yes, they are the same person."
"But …" Luo Zheng was about to say something.
Xun continued, "There are many cultivation methods in the Upper Realm. Some of them may seem inconceivable to you, but there's actually more than one Yun Luo. If you look carefully in the Lower Realm, you might be able to find a million Yun Luos."
"A million Yun Luos?" Hearing Xun's words, Luo Zheng's mouth gaped open.
Xun nodded and said, "Maybe I've underestimated her. Moreover, these million Yun Luos are indeed her."
"What's going on?" Luo Zheng asked curiously.
"It's very simple. It's because Yun Luo used a special secret method to sever millions of swords on herself. She divided her soul into millions of parts, and then divided them into many Upper Realms to cultivate and accumulate combat experience and experience." Xun said indifferently, "At a specific time, Yun Luo will retrieve all her clones. At that time, Yun Luo's cultivation will grow to a terrifying level!"
These words once again made Luo Zheng speechless.
No wonder …
When he first met Yun Luo in White Emperor City in the Eastern Region, Yun Luo had been constantly killing demons to gain experience.
And Yun Luo, who was in the Tower of Sin, was constantly fighting in the arena. Yun Luo had so many Light of Creation, but she never tried to refine them. Her cultivation had been maintained at the level of a tenth-level warlord, as if it would never improve!
Unexpectedly, these were all Yun Luo's clones …
With so many clones cultivating at the same time and then retrieving them at the same time, how much experience could they accumulate?
Luo Zheng found it hard to imagine. He could only sigh at how big the world was. There were simply too many geniuses in the Upper Realm. They were actually able to come up with such an unimaginable cultivation method.
Flying was naturally several times faster than walking. Although the Holy Tree looked very far away, they arrived in an incense stick's worth of time.
The Heavenly Feather Holy Land had probably received the news in advance. Many members of the Yao Night Clan were standing on top of the Holy Tree, waiting for them.
At the end of the Holy Tree's thickest trunk, a crimson carpet was laid out along the trunk. At the end of the carpet, there was a Yao Night Clan woman wearing purple clothes, standing there quietly.
Even though Luo Zheng was thousands of feet away from the woman, Luo Zheng could still feel the aura she emitted!
That aura was not overbearing, but it made people feel incomparably heavy. Even compared to the Battle Sages of the Demon Race and Cui Xie, who was at the Life and Death Realm, this aura was countless times stronger!

Chapter 596
Divine Sea Realm experts were peak existences in the Great Thousand Worlds!
Once they reached the Life and Death Realm or the Battle Saint realm, they would become a threat to the stability of the Great Thousand Worlds if their strength increased any further. Thus, they would encounter a 'Great Tribulation of Life and Death'!
The so-called 'Great Tribulation of Life and Death' was actually the punishment of the Great Thousand Worlds after the Great Thousand Worlds sensed danger!
After reaching the Divine Sea Realm, the punishment of the Great Thousand Worlds would no longer be able to restrain such experts, so they would be expelled. This was called 'Ascension in Broad Sky'.
However, there were still certain conditions for a Spirit Sea Realm warrior to ascend to the Upper World. Tian Yu's talent was amazing. It only took her a little more than two hundred years to cultivate from a Xiantian Realm warrior to a Spirit Sea Realm warrior. For her, ascension was still far away.
After Luo Zheng and Xun landed on the thick branch, the huge Holy Tree began to shake.
The Holy Tree was as large as a castle, and it shook like the mountains were shaking. At the same time, Liu Yu knelt down on one knee and said softly, "Welcome, my Queen."
Xun nodded calmly even in the face of a Divine Sea Realm expert's kowtow. Her expression didn't change at all, as if everything was natural.
After Liu Yu knelt down, the other Divine Sea Realm experts behind Liu Yu also knelt down. The Battle Saints of the Yao Night Clan on the other branches also knelt down.
On the Holy Tree, over a hundred thousand Yao Night Clan members knelt down at the same time!
Every single Yao Night Clan member had an incomparably pious expression on their faces.
The three 'Kings' of the Yao Night Clan were supreme existences to all Yao Night Clan members. In the millions of lower realms, the Yao Night Clan had countless Holy Lands, but the three Kings of the Yao Night Clan rarely visited the Yao Night Clan in person!
For Xun to visit the Heavenly Feather Holy Land in person, she was a supreme existence to all Yao Night Clan members!
The shaking of the Holy Tree continued to intensify, and the thick branches began to shake violently. However, Luo Zheng felt a great attraction force coming from the branches of the Holy Tree, and his feet were firmly attached to it. No matter how the Holy Tree shook, it wouldn't throw him off.
While the Holy Tree was shaking, a clearly visible vein appeared on the branches of the Holy Tree. Green rays of light followed the vein and converged on the trunk of the Holy Tree. Finally, the green rays of light continued to climb along the trunk, and finally all the green rays of light were transmitted to the branch where Luo Zheng was.
When it reached the end of the branch, the light gushed out and enveloped Smoky.
"This is …" Luo Zheng opened his mouth wide.
"This is the life force of the Sacred Tree," Mu Qingyang explained.
"Hualala …"
While the Light of Life was constantly being extracted, the originally lush green leaves on the Holy Tree were withering at a speed visible to the naked eye, falling to the ground in disarray.
It was as if spring had just arrived, and in the blink of an eye, spring had arrived!
Luo Zheng noticed that it wasn't just the huge Holy Tree that was withering. Many of the plants around the Holy Tree were also withering and turning yellow.
"If we extract the life force of the Holy Tree like this, then won't the Holy Tree also …" Looking at the withering Holy Tree, Luo Zheng was stunned.
Mu Qingyang didn't find it strange and said, "The life force of the Holy Tree is indeed very precious, and we rarely extract it. We only extract a small amount every year when we bring the newborn babies to the Holy Tree. However, our King's soul in your Sword Spirit is extremely weak, and he also suffered quite a bit of damage. This time, we will extract 90% of the Holy Tree's life force."
Seeing Luo Zheng's shocked expression, Mu Qingyang continued to smile and said, "It's alright, the Holy Tree's life force is very strong, and it won't wither because of this. It will completely recover in two or three years at most."
"So it's like that." Luo Zheng nodded.
Xun continued to absorb the life force within the Holy Tree. This kind of pure life force was very easy to absorb, and in the blink of an eye, a huge amount of green light was completely absorbed by Xun.
After absorbing the green light, Xun lowered her head and looked at Liu Yu. She said indifferently, "Stand up, and bring me to the King Statue."
"Yes, my King." Liu Yu nodded.
The number one genius of the Sea God Continent, the leader of the Sky Feather Holy Land, stood up respectfully and carefully led Xun on the crimson carpet.
Ling Yan, Mu Qingyang, and Luo Zheng followed behind them.
As for the hundreds of thousands of Yao Ye clansmen below, they were still prostrating themselves on the ground.
Walking along the crimson carpet on the tree trunk, it didn't take long for them to reach the main trunk of the Holy Tree. Inside the main trunk was a hollowed out palace.
After Liu Yu led Xun, Luo Zheng, and the others into the palace, the Yao Ye clansmen who had been prostrating on the ground stood up.
The Yao Ye clansmen, who had been completely silent, suddenly became excited.
"I saw the King! It really is the King! She looks exactly the same as the King Statue! "
"Why has the King come to our Sky Feather Holy Land? She's the King of Slaughter in our Yao Ye Clan. I remember that among the three King Statues, her King Statue seems to be dim … "
"Shh, don't speak nonsense! If you're heard, you'll be punished! "
"Something must have happened in the Upper Realm. Otherwise, how could our King, a Sword Spirit, live in a human's body?"
Actually, these speculations had begun to circulate as soon as Fei 'er notified the Sky Feather Holy Land.
The King Statue flickered with eternal holy light, and it never dimmed day or night.
However, in recent years, the King Statue had suddenly dimmed. This was an ominous sign. It wasn't just the Sky Feather Holy Land; Xun's King Statue in the other Greater Thousand Worlds had also dimmed!
A long time ago, many people from the Yao Night Clan had guessed that some sort of unexpected event had occurred in the Yao Night Clan from the Upper Realms.
Unfortunately, this wasn't something they could guess.
However, because of Xun's sudden arrival, their guesses had been confirmed. However, Liu Yu and the others naturally didn't have the right to ask why Xun had become like this.
After entering the enormous palace, Xun walked towards the center of the palace.
In the center of the palace, there were three enormous statues. All three statues were of female members of the Yao Ye Clan.
The three statues were very lifelike, and each of them had their own luster. The first statue was holding a huge scepter, and its whole body was emitting a faint green halo. Just by getting close to the green statue, one could feel the vigorous life force within it.
"This is the King of Life in our Yao Ye Clan," Mu Qingyang said when he saw Luo Zheng's gaze on the statue.
Luo Zheng nodded, and his gaze shifted to the second statue. The second statue radiated a dark blue light, and she held a murderous meteor hammer! It was hard to imagine that the Yao Ye Clan would use such a barbaric and cruel weapon.
"She's the King of Punishments in our clan," Mu Qingyang said.
"I see." Luo Zheng continued to look at the last statue.
The last statue was completely red, but the only difference was that the red light it emitted was very dim. It was far less dazzling than the other two statues!
This statue's appearance and body were almost exactly the same as Xun's!
"No wonder the Nightfiend clan was able to tell at a glance that Xun was the king of the Nightfiend clan. They do look exactly the same," Luo Zheng thought to himself. But … why was Xun's statue holding a spear?
Wasn't Xun a swordsman?
Back then, Luo Zheng had unexpectedly obtained a sword spirit after entering the Massacre Sword Mountain. The only place where Luo Zheng and Xun communicated was the Massacre Sword Mountain.
Since Xun had entered the Massacre Sword Mountain, she must have comprehended the perfect sword intent. She must be a swordsman. However, it seemed that her main weapon wasn't a sword, but a spear?
While Luo Zheng was puzzled, Xun stopped in front of her statue. She suddenly turned around and said to Liu Yu, "You can all leave. Luo Zheng, stay. Without my order, no one is allowed to enter the palace."
As Luo Zheng's sword spirit, Xun couldn't stay too far away from Luo Zheng, so Luo Zheng naturally had to stay.
"Yes, my King. Without your order, no one is allowed to enter the palace." Liu Yu nodded and immediately led Ling Yan and the others, as well as the other Divine Sea Realm cultivators behind them, out of the palace.

Chapter 597
Only Luo Zheng and his "sword spirit" were left in the empty palace.

So that's why …

Luo Zheng's eyes had been baptized by the sap of the Tree of God, so he could clearly see the changes in the statue through the blue light.

For a clan, this method was very useful. Perhaps the upper realm couldn't transmit resources to the lower realm, but the statues could transmit information that the lower realm shouldn't have, such as secret cultivation methods and so on.
Was Kaoru seeking the help of another king?

The azure statue was the Demon Night Clan's King of Punishment, while He Xun was the King of Slaughter. Luo Zheng didn't expect the two of them to curse like shrews on the streets. How could he endure this? No wonder Xun wanted all the members of the Demon Night Clan to leave.

With your current appearance, let alone killing your way back, you're just a Divine Core human boy. I don't think you can even leave this world! "

"I really didn't expect your luck to be so good! You even managed to find someone with the Fate of Battle of the Worlds! "

You don't have the ability to turn the tables! "

After all, the King statue was not an Immortal Artifact or a Saint Artifact. It was impossible to carve such a hard material. Although the King of the Fiend Night Clan had used a great divine ability to attach to the statue, due to the "material" she was made of, she did not pose much of a threat to Luo Zheng.
When the King statue swung the meteor hammer at him a second time, Luo Zheng suddenly punched out and smashed the meteor hammer into pieces …

"Sword!"

Luo Zheng pouted. He really did not know what to say …
After thinking for a long time, Luo Zheng said, "You, you came here just to quarrel with her?"
Xun nodded and admitted it. "Yes!"
Although Luo Zheng had already determined from the conversation between the two of them that she was here to quarrel, such a weird way of quarreling still made Luo Zheng fall to the ground.
"But …" Luo Zheng spread his hands. He looked at Xun's expression and wanted to say something to comfort her. However, he did not know about the conflict between Xun and that woman.
"You'll help me, right?" Xun looked at Luo Zheng in a daze. This was the first time she had asked Luo Zheng for a favor.
This was an internal strife of the Fiend Night Clan. Luo Zheng would not be wise to rashly get involved in this!
The Fiend Night Clan was a large clan that was not inferior to the True Dragon Clan!
Since the three statues in front of him were the Kings of the Fiend Night Clan, their strength was far beyond what Luo Zheng could estimate …
"I'm afraid I'm not strong enough," Luo Zheng shook his head.
Although Luo Zheng had just become a champion, his strength was clearly not enough. Not to mention the King who controlled punishment, even Liu Yu of the Heavenly Feather Holy Land and many other Divine Ocean Realm cultivators could crush him with a single finger!
Xun stared at Luo Zheng and said, "You're indeed not strong enough right now. However, you're the most important chess piece. You'll eventually return to your position!"

Chapter 598
"Chess piece?"
Luo Zheng asked, puzzled.
"Yes, the Era of Evolution has begun! Many geniuses have appeared in the world, and you bear the destiny of the Era of Evolution. As long as you don't die, you are destined to become the main character of this era! "Xun said seriously.
Regarding this Battle of the Great Era, Luo Zheng had always vaguely understood it.
Both Qinglong and Immortal Tian Miao were secretive about it. Every time they talked about the key points, they wouldn't talk about it. Luo Zheng couldn't understand the whole truth.
"The Era of Evolution? What's the meaning of that? "Luo Zheng asked again.
Xun said lightly, "Haven't you noticed that there are many geniuses in this era? Even in this Great Thousand World, there are countless geniuses who suddenly appear, not to mention the millions of Great Thousand Worlds and many Upper Realms. "
Hearing Xun's words, Luo Zheng immediately understood. She was right!
Since Luo Zheng had come from the Blue Cloud Sect, he had seen many geniuses appear out of nowhere.
The Blue Cloud Sect was only a small second-grade sect. In the past competitions of all sects, it was rare to see someone with the Great Achievement Sword Intent. There had never been a swordsman with the Perfect Achievement Sword Intent. However, in the last competition of the Blue Cloud Sect, there were two such swordsmen. One was Luo Zheng himself, and the other was Hua Tianming.
Not only the Blue Cloud Sect, but also various god-level geniuses appeared in the Martial Arts Competition held on the Rising Dragon Platform!
According to the classification of talents in the Central Domain, as long as a god-level genius didn't die, he was destined to enter the Spirit Sea Realm. However, for so many years, no one in the Central Domain had ever reached the Spirit Sea Realm!
Therefore, Luo Zheng wasn't the only one who found it strange. All the sects in the Central Domain were also puzzled. What was wrong with this world?
After listening to Xun's explanation, Luo Zheng finally understood that the Era of Evolution was coming …
"I need you to help me," Xun stared at Luo Zheng and said. Her face was full of stubbornness. She bit her lip and said, "Please!"
Who would have thought that the high and mighty king of the Demon Night Clan, the king of slaughter, would beg someone for help?
As he gazed at Xun's miserable yet persistent expression, Luo Zheng's heart thumped slightly. He knew clearly that agreeing to Xun's request wasn't a wise choice. After all, Xun only had a strand of her soul left. Her identity might be useful in the Lower Realm, but once they returned to the Upper Realm, Luo Zheng might have to face the entire Nightfiend Clan!
This race may be even more powerful than human beings. Luo Zheng still looked hesitant.
Seeing Luo Zheng's expression, Xun was slightly disappointed. She pursed her lips and said sadly, "That's right. I'm just your sword spirit. I'm not your sister, and I'm not someone you care about. Moreover, to you, I'm still an alien …"
As Luo Zheng's sword spirit, Xun had always been hiding in Luo Zheng's body. Naturally, she knew everything that had happened to Luo Zheng.
Of course, she knew that if it were Luo Zheng's sister, Luo Yan, the Hall Master of the Cloud Hall, Ning Yudie, or even Princess Su Lingyun of the Sky-Burning Empire, Luo Zheng would have done everything he could to help. He was not someone who didn't care about relationships!
Xun was only Luo Zheng's sword spirit. She didn't have any feelings for Luo Zheng …
At this moment, an old voice suddenly floated out of Luo Zheng's mind, "Little girl, Luo Zheng can help you."
Luo Zheng was slightly stunned. Actually, he really wanted to help Xun, but he was hesitant. The path of a warrior was extremely difficult. There were dangers everywhere. Even if he was lucky, one wrong step could lead to his doom. Even if he was lucky, he would still die, not to mention that he had the destiny of the Battle of the Ages!
Just like those god-level geniuses, they claimed that they would definitely reach the Divine Sea Realm. But how many of them actually reached the Divine Sea Realm? Probably less than one in a hundred!
Because if a god-level genius wanted to become a powerful warrior of the Divine Sea Realm, they had to "not die"!
Could Luo Zheng become the main character of this era? The premise was still "not die".
Faced with a race that was even more powerful than human beings, how could Luo Zheng agree so easily?
But just as Luo Zheng was hesitating, Qinglong suddenly answered for him. Luo Zheng was naturally puzzled.
Qinglong had always been wise and was known for its vast knowledge. Since it agreed to Xun's request on behalf of Luo Zheng, there must be a deeper meaning …
Xun wasn't surprised by the voice in Luo Zheng's mind. Although Xun was Luo Zheng's sword spirit and couldn't enter Luo Zheng's mind, Luo Zheng had borrowed the help of Qinglong's soul many times when he was drawing runes.
With Xun's vision, she could see where the soul belonged.
Hearing that voice, Xun stared at Luo Zheng and said, "You agreeing is useless. Luo Zheng agreeing is useful!"
"Luo Zheng, agree to her request. The Fiendish Night Clan will be of great help to you. If you can really help her regain her throne, you will benefit a lot in the future," Qinglong said calmly.
"I don't care about benefits," Luo Zheng said seriously, "What's more, as my sword spirit, you have saved my life many times! I can't promise you too much, but if I have the ability in the future, I can help you! "
After Luo Zheng finished speaking, Xun's gloomy face suddenly lit up as if a ray of light shone on her face. She gazed at Luo Zheng and finally lowered her head and said, "Thank you …"
Luo Zheng smiled. "But you are still a sword spirit. You can't always be my sword spirit and stay in my body, right?"
"I will think of a way to reconstruct my body, but I can't do it right now," Xun said after thinking for a while.
Being a sword spirit was indeed a bit troublesome for Xun, but its advantages were obvious. As a sword spirit, she couldn't be killed. Even if she was cut into pieces, she could still easily recover. As long as Luo Zheng didn't die, she would be an immortal existence.
However, she could only hide in Luo Zheng's body. Even if she revealed her true form, she would have to keep a certain distance from Luo Zheng.
However, reconstructing her body wasn't a simple matter. She could only rely on her luck in the future to see if she had the chance.
At this moment, Xun suddenly said, "Isn't your biggest goal now to save your sister? I can order Liu Yu to bring the Fiendish Night Clan to the Central Domain and help you kill Cui Xie. "
"Help me kill Cui Xie?" Luo Zheng's eyebrows suddenly jumped.
Xun's suggestion was indeed feasible!
Cui Xie's cultivation was at the Life and Death Realm, and he had only passed the third layer of the Life and Death Tribulation.
His strength was roughly equivalent to a third level Battle-Saint!
In the Heavenly Feather Holy Ground, there were at least a million third level Battle-Saints. Even if Cui Xie's strength was far greater than an ordinary Battle-Saint's, the Heavenly Feather Holy Ground still had Liu Yu, a Divine Sea Realm expert.
With their strength, killing Cui Xie wouldn't be too difficult.
If Luo Zheng brought the Fiendish Night Clan's Holy Ground back to the Central Domain, they would probably be able to sweep through all the sects in the Central Domain.
The gap between a Holy Ground and a fifth grade sect was this big, not to mention that the Heavenly Feather Holy Ground was a seventh grade Holy Ground!
However, Luo Zheng still shook his head. His eyes were filled with determination. "Cui Xie has already become an obstacle in my Heart of Martial Dao. This obstacle … I have to clear it myself!"
Although the Heart of Martial Dao couldn't increase a cultivator's combat strength, it was extremely important for a cultivator. If the Heart of Martial Dao wasn't smooth, Luo Zheng wouldn't be able to overcome this knot in his heart. This knot would eventually become Luo Zheng's Heart Demon, becoming the biggest obstacle in his life!
This kind of obstacle could cause Luo Zheng's cultivation to be unable to progress. In the worst case, it could cause Luo Zheng's cultivation to go berserk and die at a critical moment.
When Cui Xie transformed into a giant face and appeared in the sky above the Blue Cloud Sect, Luo Zheng had already sworn to himself that he would personally take Cui Xie's life while he was still alive!
"I won't use the hands of others to kill Cui Xie," Luo Zheng said, shaking his head.
With Xun's experience, she naturally understood the meaning behind Luo Zheng's words. Since she had already obtained a promise from Luo Zheng, Xun's goal had already been achieved to a certain extent.
She was the King of Slaughter, and her Slaughter True Body had been destroyed due to her carelessness. She was already in a situation where she had lost everything.
Because this clone of hers hadn't dispersed, even though her statue was dim and lusterless, it still hadn't been extinguished. According to the rules of the Yaowe Clan, the next King of Slaughter would only be chosen if the glow within her statue vanished completely!
As long as her Soul Clone wasn't destroyed, she would have a sliver of hope to turn the tables. All of Xun's hopes were pinned on this human youth …
As such, from now on, Xun would naturally fully cooperate with Luo Zheng!
Xun then walked to the entrance of the palace and allowed the Yao Night Clan members outside to enter.
When Liu Yu and the others saw the shattered statue and the giant black sword stabbed into the ground, their expressions changed drastically.
The King Statue was a sacred object to the Yao Night Clan!
It wasn't that the material of the statue was precious, it was just that these statues were the symbol of their faith. Normally, if anyone accidentally touched a king statue, they would receive the most severe punishment. Now that it had been shattered, how could their expressions not change?
However …
The giant black sword was Xun's weapon.
Many of the Yao Night Clan members had seen it in the Tower of Sin. It seemed that their King had personally shattered the statue.
Why was this so?
Was there some kind of conflict between the two Kings?
Liu Yu and the other Divine Sea Realm cultivators guessed, but they didn't dare to directly ask Xun what had happened.
Luo Zheng couldn't help but laugh inwardly when he saw the expressions on Liu Yu and the others' faces. 'I wonder what your expressions would be like if you saw the two high and mighty Kings of your Night Demon Clan cursing and swearing like shrews …'
"Clean it up. Don't erect this statue again," Xun said calmly. She had regained her arrogant expression and was emitting the aura of a King.
"Don't erect it anymore?" Liu Yu was stunned.
The three King Statues couldn't be missing. This was the rule of the Yao Night Clan's Holy Lands. How could they not erect it?
If anyone else had said this, they would have been executed by the Yao Night Clan …
The problem was that their "King" had said it herself.
Xun thought about it and sighed. "Forget it. Let's just carve another one. Remember, make it uglier!"
Hearing Xun's words, Luo Zheng almost laughed out loud. This woman was truly terrifying. Once she developed a grudge against someone, she wouldn't stop until one of them was dead!
Liu Yu and the others, on the other hand, had a look of fear and trepidation on their faces, as if they did not know what to do.
Xun calmly walked in the front while Luo Zheng followed behind her. The higher-ups of the Yao Night Clan followed closely behind them.
The Yao Night Clan's King acted one way in front of Luo Zheng, but acted another way in front of others.
This giant Holy Tree was hollow in the middle. Within the Holy Tree's trunk was a palace that was over a hundred stories tall.
Under Xun's request, Liu Yu led Luo Zheng to the treasury of the Yao Night Clan's Holy Lands to choose a weapon.
Even though the Demon Blood Emperor's greatsword was powerful, it wasn't of a high grade. Furthermore, when he fought with Mu Qingyang in the Tower of Sins, Mu Qingyang's claw had left a few deep grooves on it. Even though it could still be used, it might break at any moment. Right now, Xun needed to choose a weapon.
A Rank 7 Holy Land's foundation far surpassed that of the Cloud Hall and the Void Spirit Sect.
In the Central Domain, low-grade Saint weapons were extremely rare. However, they weren't rare on the Sea God's Continent. Therefore, when the Demon Race offered ten Saint weapons in exchange for Luo Zheng's life in the Tower of Sin, Zhao Fenqin immediately rejected the offer.
After passing through the top floor and the roots of the Holy Tree, Luo Zheng finally arrived at the treasury of the Yao Night Clan.
When Luo Zheng entered the treasury of the Rank 7 Holy Land, he couldn't help but sigh.
In the center of the treasure vault, there was a huge luminous pearl that emitted a gentle glow. Surrounding the luminous pearl were a dozen swords that were stabbed into the ground at a slanted angle!
All of them were Saint weapons!
"My Queen, the best weapon in our Sky Feather Holy Land is a high-grade Saint weapon," Liu Yu introduced.
"Take a look," Xun said calmly.
Liu Yu nodded. He led Luo Zheng and Xun to the back of the luminous pearl. Then, he reached out and pulled out a long box from the ground. After placing the box on the ground, Liu Yu casually opened it and pulled out a longsword.
It was a pale golden longsword, and the blade was shining with an ancient light.
"I obtained this high-grade Saint weapon from the Xuanming Cave. However, I'm not good with swords, so I sealed it here," Liu Yu said.
"Good sword!" Luo Zheng's eyes suddenly flashed.
A high-grade Saint weapon actually came from the Xuanming Cave. What kind of opportunities existed in the Xuanming Cave?
Xun looked at the pale golden longsword with an indifferent gaze. She gently extended her slender fingers.
Liu Yu held the longsword with both hands and respectfully handed it to Xun. Then, he retreated to the side.
Xun gently waved the pale golden longsword in a circle. Finally, she shook her head. "I have no use for this sword. I'll give it to Luo Zheng."
Hearing Xun's words, Liu Yu's face showed a trace of depression. Give a high-grade Saint weapon to this human warrior?
Although Liu Yu knew that the Queen and Luo Zheng were almost inseparable, she had used all her strength to obtain this sword in the Xuanming Cave. She had almost lost her life there to obtain this sword. Now, she was giving it to a foreign race warrior …
Naturally, she felt a little uncomfortable.
"Can't I?" Xun sensed Liu Yu's expression and said indifferently.
Liu Yu immediately lowered his head and said, "My Queen, it's up to you to decide who you want to give it to."
"Mm." Xun nodded. Then, she gave it to Luo Zheng.
The Yao Night Clan was like this. The entire clan was centered around the three Kings. This was because Xun and the other two Kings were the faith of thousands of people in the Yao Night Clan. They did not have any thoughts of disobedience.
Xun had only taken Liu Yu's sword. Even if Xun ordered Liu Yu to commit suicide, Liu Yu would not disobey!
From this, it could be seen that the structure of the Yao Night Clan was completely different from that of the human race.
Among humans, there was no absolute obedience. As long as the benefits of betrayal were great enough, even father and son could betray the other party, not to mention the other party.
Therefore, from this perspective, the Yao Night Clan was far more united than the human race! It was impossible for there to be a situation like in the Central Domain where the large sects attacked each other …
Just like that, he obtained a high-grade saint ranked sword. Luo Zheng's heart was pounding.
Although he had a low-grade Saint Grade sword, there was no end to weapons for cultivators. There was no best, only better!
"I don't need a sword now …" Xun shook her head and said, "I want to use my original weapon. I want a spear!"
When Xun was young, she did use a sword. However, when she was chosen as the King of the Yao Night Clan and started to control killing, she switched to using a spear. She had used a spear longer than she had used a sword, so it was much easier for her to use it.
At that time, Luo Zheng simply thought that Xun was her sword spirit and naturally gave her a sword. However, only by using a spear could Xun display her full strength!
Flowing Feather nodded. With a wave of her hand, an invisible force swept out, and a silver spear spiraled out of a box in the distance.
"This spear is the best spear in the Sky Feather Holy Land. Please have a look, my King." Liu Yu handed the spear to Xun.
This spear's grade couldn't compare to Luo Zheng's sword, but it wasn't low either. It was a mid-grade Saint Grade spear.
Xun held the silver spear in her hand and looked forward. Then, she stabbed the spear into the void!
An extremely unique energy fluctuation immediately pierced out!
That energy wave not only shocked Luo Zheng, but also shocked Liu Yu, who was a Divine Sea Realm cultivator.
Xun was a sword spirit, and a sword spirit's strength increased with its master's strength!
Although a sword spirit couldn't be divided into cultivation levels, it should be on par with Luo Zheng's or even slightly weaker than Luo Zheng's.
Xun's spear couldn't hurt a Divine Sea Realm cultivator like Liu Yu, but the power contained within it was far from what Liu Yu could comprehend.

Chapter 599
She put away the silver spear and saw Luo Zheng's shocked expression. She said calmly, "It's a pity that you're a sword cultivator. Otherwise, I could teach you the spear techniques of the Yao Ye Clan."
Although Xun had been a sword cultivator before the age of twenty, the sword techniques she had cultivated back then were not the top-tier techniques of the Yao Ye Clan. Furthermore, Luo Zheng was a grown man, so it was difficult for him to display the agility of a sword dance. It was not as good as the sword techniques Luo Zheng had comprehended himself.
However, her spear techniques were different. It was one of the most elite techniques of the Yao Ye Clan.
Luo Zheng blinked. Since he had chosen the sword out of all the other weapons, he would not give it up so easily.
It was taboo for cultivators to be greedy. Moreover, if Luo Zheng wanted to practice the spear, he would have to start from scratch. It was like picking up a watermelon and throwing away a sesame seed. He would not do such a thing.
However, when Liu Yu heard this, she had a different feeling.
The techniques of the three kings of the Yao Ye Clan could not be taught to outsiders. Even the other kings of the Yao Ye Clan could not learn them. However, from the king's tone, she seemed to have no qualms …
Combined with the broken king statues in the palace, Liu Yu guessed that something big had happened in the Upper Realm.
Unfortunately, this was not something that Liu Yu could guess. Liu Yu might have been a leader in a seventh-rank holy land, but a Divine Sea Realm cultivator like her was nothing in the Yao Ye Clan after ascending. At most, she could be considered the leader of a small team.
Liu Yu was not qualified to participate in a battle between kings.
Unless Liu Yu could become a powerhouse of the Yao Ye Clan in the Upper Realm …
However, Liu Yu had already been tested on the Talent Monument. Although her name was high on the second row of the Talent Monument, this talent was indeed very shocking in the Sea God Continent. However, in the Upper Realm, it was just so-so.
At the very least, there were five names above Liu Yu's head back then. Now, there were even two additional names, Luo Zheng and Yun Luo. Although she did not enter the Sin Tower, the various spies the Holy Lands had planted were shuttling back and forth between the Holy Land and the Sin Tower. Everything that happened in the Sin Tower would be reported to the Holy Land.
Liu Yu naturally knew that Luo Zheng had kicked the two Battle-Saints out of the Tower of Sin in an instant.
Similarly, she did not dare to neglect this human brat in front of her. If Luo Zheng had the ability to kick any living being out of the Tower of Sin, then Luo Zheng was actually the true controller of the Tower of Sin!
All the races on the Sea God Continent were attached to the Tower of Sin.
Even Liu Yu had relied on the Tower of Sin to raise her cultivation base and fully display her talent to this day. At the same time, she had obtained a great opportunity in the Xuanming Cave, which allowed her to achieve her current status.
"I've finished choosing my weapon. Luo Zheng, you can continue to choose." Xun handed the spear to Luo Zheng and had Luo Zheng store it in his Sumeru Ring. She was still Luo Zheng's sword spirit and could not store anything. This spear could only be used when she needed to fight.
She wanted to get a spear today because she knew that Luo Zheng would face more and more pressure. With Xun's current strength, she might not be able to display even a millionth of her former strength. However, this spear could help Luo Zheng turn the situation around at a critical moment. This was the best she could do.
Although Luo Zheng already had a high-grade Sage Grade sword in his hand, after hearing Xun's words, Luo Zheng still began to look around. Looking at the dazzling array of Immortal and Sage Grade weapons, Luo Zheng shook his head and finally asked, "Do you have any high-quality crystals?"
"Crystals?"
Hearing Luo Zheng's request, Liu Yu revealed a strange expression. Those crystals were used to inlay weapons. Could it be that Luo Zheng was a Tool Refiner? He wanted to refine magic weapons?
Of course, Luo Zheng was not a Tool Refiner.
Back in White Emperor City, Luo Zheng had obtained two crystals and inlaid them in his arms.
These two crystals had indeed been of great help to Luo Zheng. Phoenix Soaring Crystals were originally inlaid in weapons to reduce their weight and make them more flexible and faster. After being inlaid in Luo Zheng's body, they could greatly increase Luo Zheng's speed.
When Luo Zheng was at the Xiantian level, the Phoenix Soaring Crystals could greatly increase his speed. However, for the current Luo Zheng, the increase in speed was negligible.
As for the Blood Jade Crystals, although the energy contained in them could destroy barriers, the barriers Luo Zheng encountered now were often used to trap War Generals and War Venerables. A single Blood Jade Crystal was no longer of much use.
Therefore, Luo Zheng had been looking for an opportunity to replace the crystals inlaid in his arms. Now that Liu Yu had asked him to make a request, Luo Zheng naturally would not let go of this opportunity. Given the resources of a seventh-rank Holy Land, it shouldn't be difficult for them to take out two high-grade crystals.
"Yes, the crystals inlaid in weapons." Luo Zheng nodded.
"You want to inlay them in weapons?" Liu Yu asked curiously.
"You can say that …" Luo Zheng himself could be considered a weapon, so there was nothing wrong with saying this.
Liu Yu nodded to a nearby Demon Night Clan Battle Sage, who walked towards a corner of the treasury.
Liu Yu would personally take out a weapon for Luo Zheng, but as a Divine Sea Realm expert, she naturally wouldn't do it herself.
Not long after, the Battle-Saint took out an embroidered box from the corner of the treasury. Inside the embroidered box was a box of multicolored crystals. These crystals were of different shapes and sizes and were all polished to a certain size.
"Some of these crystals are Fire Condensing Crystals from the depths of active volcanoes, while others are Purple Cloud Crystals from deep sea trenches. They all have different effects, but how many do you need to match an Immortal Artifact or even a Sacred Artifact?"
According to Tian Yu's guess, either Luo Zheng himself was a Weapon Refiner, or he had a friend who was. If he simply used them to refine a weapon, there was still a chance of failure when inlaying the crystals. He would need at least 10 or 20 crystals, right?
However, Luo Zheng nodded and said, "Two."
"Only two?" Tian Yu became more and more curious about Luo Zheng's request. Of course, Luo Zheng couldn't tell Liu Yu that he wanted to inlay these crystals in his body.
Following this, the Demon Night Clan's Battle-Saint introduced the crystals to Luo Zheng, allowing him to understand their uses. Luo Zheng picked out two of the crystals according to his needs.
Back then, Luo Zheng chose the Phoenix Soaring Crystal because Luo Zheng's speed was his shortcoming. However, now that Luo Zheng had comprehended the Law of Space, this shortcoming no longer existed. Luo Zheng chose the two crystals according to his own ideas.
After choosing the crystals, Luo Zheng didn't have any other requests. Then, Tian Yu brought Luo Zheng and Xun back to the Sacred Tree.
Xun's purpose on this trip to the Sky Feather Sacred Ground was to quarrel with the King in charge of punishment. However, Luo Zheng didn't come out empty-handed. At the very least, he obtained a high-grade Sacred Artifact and replaced the two crystals in his arm.
Two days later, Luo Zheng, Ling Yan, Mu Qing Yang, and the others left the Sky Feather Sacred Ground and went to the Sin Tower again.
During these two days, Liu Yu had made it clear to Luo Zheng that if Luo Zheng wanted to cleanse the Sin Tower of the Demon Race, the Demon Night Clan would do their best to help!
The Demon Race wasn't a friendly race. They loved to kill and had a cruel temperament, which was contrary to the Demon Night Clan's nature of harmony and order. Moreover, the Demon Night Clan had been targeted by the Demon Race in both the Sin Tower and the Deep Sea Continent. It was only after Liu Yu led the Sky Feather Sacred Ground to rise that the Demon Race restrained themselves.
If there was a chance to cleanse the Demon Race now, Liu Yu wouldn't let it go. As a Divine Sea Realm expert and the leader of the Demon Night Clan, Liu Yu wasn't a soft-hearted person. This was the world. Kindness to the enemy was cruelty to oneself.
After passing through the teleportation array, Luo Zheng returned to the Sin Tower.
The two doors at the entrance of the Sin Tower that had been smashed by the Demon Race's Battle Saint had been repaired.
Before Luo Zheng left, what happened on the 10th floor hadn't been spread. However, after Luo Zheng left the Sin Tower and stayed in the Sky Feather Sacred Ground for a few days, all kinds of news had spread through the various channels of the Sin Tower.
Everyone knew what happened on the 10th floor. As for who spread the news and whether it was intentional, no one knew. However, the Demon Race had restrained themselves a lot during this time.

Chapter 600
When Luo Zheng stepped into the first floor of the Tower of Sin, the eyes of the various races stared at him. Most of them were filled with reverence.
As for the many Demon Race fighters, their eyes were filled with fear.
This human warrior who was not even twenty years old had only been in the Tower of Sin for three months, but he had already turned the situation around for the entire human race.
He was just a small warrior. Before this, he was even a warrior. Many of the peak War Reverends in the Tower of Sin were helpless against him. Furthermore, he had even used the power of the Cursed Lands to kill two demon Battle Saints!
This could no longer be described as a miracle.
Regardless of the process, Luo Zheng had indeed done it. Furthermore, he had completely suppressed the arrogance of the demon race.
In the past, from the first floor to the fourteenth floor of the Tower of Sin, regardless of whether it was the demon warriors or the demon warriors, they were superior to everyone else. Apart from the Yao Night Clan, the other races could only swallow their anger in front of the demon race!
No race dared to directly oppose the demon race. This powerful race had the most seats in the Tower of Sin, and they also had the most powerful force on the Sea God Continent.
The reason they were so arrogant was because they had the backing of powerful strength.
But recently, the Mo Race had indeed been very restrained. From the Mo Race warriors to the Battle Generals, and even the War Venerables, they did not speak as much as they did in the past. One could even find traces of icy coldness on the faces of the Mo Race.
This was because they did not know what Luo Zheng planned to do after returning to the Tower of Sin.
Was he going to expel all the demons? Or was he going to directly kill them?
That day, Luo Zheng seemed to have directly used some kind of power from the Tower of Sin to expel the two demon Battle Saints from the Tower of Sin!
As for whether Luo Zheng could directly use the power of the Tower of Sin to kill the living beings in the Tower of Sin, or what other methods he had, it all depended on Luo Zheng's degree of control over the Tower of Sin. Outsiders were unable to guess. The origin of the Tower of Sin was originally very mysterious. Even now, many living beings on the Sea God Continent did not know the origin of the Tower of Sin, nor did they know the secrets of the Cursed Lands.
In short, the Demon Race was like a fish on a chopping board. The situation was very passive. As for whether the Demon Race would lose or try to make peace, they could only wait and see.
After entering the first floor of the Tower of Sin, Luo Zheng looked at Ling Yan and the others. Suddenly, he smiled and said: "You guys take the stairs. I want to take another path."
Ling Yan and the other Peak War Reverends of the Yao Ye Clan, as well as Mu Qing Yang and the other generals, looked at Luo Zheng strangely. There was only one way to the lower levels of the Tower of Sin. Did Luo Zheng have another way?
However, as soon as Luo Zheng finished his words, a circular crack suddenly appeared under Luo Zheng's feet. That crack was only big enough for one person to fall through. Luo Zheng stood on top of the crack and instantly fell through it …
Seeing this scene, the faces of the Peak War Elder, including Ling Yan, were filled with astonishment. How could they play like this in the Tower of Sin?
"Boom!"
Luo Zheng steadily landed on the second floor of the Tower of Sin.
The warriors on the second floor were shocked when they saw the ceiling crack open and a human general fall down.
Luo Zheng only glanced at the warriors indifferently. Then, another circular crack appeared under his feet.
At the same time, cracks appeared on the third floor, fourth floor, fifth floor, sixth floor …
Luo Zheng's body fell vertically. In just two or three breaths of time, Luo Zheng's feet heavily stepped on the floor of the tenth floor!
From the third floor to the ninth floor, the warriors and generals only saw a shadow suddenly shoot down. They did not see who it was.
When Luo Zheng instantly stood on the floor of the tenth floor, the cracks above his head began to wriggle and quickly disappeared, leaving behind the stunned expressions of the many creatures.
"What did you just see?"
"It seems like a human fell down …"
"This … I'm afraid this is the fastest speed to enter the Tower of Sin?"
Even a peak war reverend on the fifteenth floor would have to climb down level by level after leaving the Tower of Sin. In the competition between war reverends, there had indeed been cases of people breaking the ceiling and falling to the next floor. The floors of the Tower of Sin only had the ability to heal themselves, but they were not particularly sturdy. However, no war reverend dared to break the ceiling layer by layer and drill down …
On the tenth floor's arena, a nimble figure was constantly flying. It was the human race's god rank genius, Xia Shuang.
And Xia Shuang's opponent was a giant that was close to forty feet tall!
Xia Shuang had originally cultivated an ice-type cultivation technique. Her piercing cold Qi formed many rings, encircling the giant's body.
The giants on the Sea God Continent were all extremely strong. Not to mention the human race, even the devil race would be smashed into meat paste by a punch from the giant!
However, the giant race's weakness was obvious. Their reactions were too slow and their speed could not keep up.
Now that Xia Shuang was constantly using the ice rings to suppress the giant, the giant's speed was even slower. Although the giant was constantly waving the black iron club in its hand, it could not even touch Xia Shuang's sleeves!
When Luo Zheng suddenly appeared on the tenth floor of the Tower of Sin, Xia Shuang's eyes suddenly flashed and a smile appeared on her face. True essence flickered between her eyebrows and the cold air on her body suddenly erupted!
A pair of wings condensed from ice formed behind her back. Then, she turned into a stream of light and rushed towards the giant.
Perhaps she hoped to show off her strength in front of Luo Zheng, or perhaps she was anxious to walk down the arena to see Luo Zheng, but Xia Shuang actually directly used her trump card!
As a god rank genius of the human race, Xia Shuang was considered an outstanding figure on the tenth floor. Originally, she did not need to use her trump card to deal with this giant.
"Swift Ice Feather!"
At this moment, Xia Shuang was like a fairy in the snow. She suddenly floated towards the giant. Facing the black iron cudgel that was smashing towards her, Xia Shuang's figure made a strange turn in the air, easily dodging the powerful cudgel!
Then her figure quickly approached the giant. She stretched out her snow-white hand and gently touched the giant's neck.
A seed of ice and snow was instantly planted.
"Crackle …"
A white light flashed on the giant's neck. Then, the cold power of ice blossomed into a beautiful ice flower on the giant's neck.
At the same time, the blood vessels on the giant's arms, chest, and legs cracked at the same time. All the blood vessels on the giant's body were frozen and burst open in an instant. The moment the blood sputtered out, it had already solidified!
"Plop …"
The giant's incomparably huge body fell on the arena with a loud bang. Xia Shuang stood firmly on one side of the arena. A Light of Good Fortune shot out from the giant's body and drilled into the nameplate on Xia Shuang's chest.
"Clap clap clap …" A crisp sound of applause rang out.
Luo Zheng slowly walked towards the arena. He stretched out his hands and gently clapped. At this moment, all the living beings on the tenth floor were focused on Luo Zheng.
In the few days that Luo Zheng had left, many humans had already felt the subtle changes in the Tower of Sin!
In this situation, even a fool would understand that the human race was about to rise …
In the past, as long as the human race stepped onto the arena, they would be ridiculed and targeted by the other races. In the process of battle, it was hard to count on the other side to hold back. Therefore, the human race's battle generals would usually either die or be injured when they stepped onto the arena!
Now, in the past few days, the other side would be very careful when a mortal battle general stepped onto the arena. Even after defeating the human battle general, they would not follow up with a victorious attack and take the human battle general's life!
This change made many humans very happy. They were very clear that this change originated from one person, Luo Zheng.
Although the human race only had four seats on the top floor, it would not be long before the human race's number of seats would increase. As for how much it would increase, it would depend on how far the demon race would retreat. It would depend on the demon race's countermeasures, and it would also depend on Luo Zheng's methods!
And today, Luo Zheng had returned.
Xia Shuang smiled when she saw Luo Zheng clapping for her. Then, she briskly jumped off the arena and walked towards Luo Zheng.
